title: Lead Logistics Coordinator-PE015
description:
Lead Logistics Coordinator

Located in Ct Market.

Capstone Logistics is the premier provider of 3rd Party services in distribution centers across the nation. With a foot print of over 400 DCs in 45 states and Canada, Capstone is the preferred partner for many major retailers, grocers and specialty companies. With high-growth expected this year, we are looking for top talent that is interested in career opportunities to grow with us!

This position is designed to communicate effectively with both vendors and customers to ensure that deliveries are consistently made on time as we work to meet the needs of our customers. Will report directly to the Logistics Manager

  • Work Days & Shift Start times:
  • M-F 4:00pm -12:30am (2nd shift)
  • Hourly Rate $24-$26

Job Description

Lead Logistics Coordinator s expected to help with dispatch and assist drivers. Assist with overseeing billing and daily coordinator functions and make sure everything is done by deadlines given by management. Make sure all settlements are filled out properly and passed on to Logistics Manager. Need to be organized, a great communicator, and manages time well. The Lead LC will be the Logistics Managers main point for updates and issues reports when needed.

  • Schedule and dispatch vendors or independent contractors to appropriate locations according to customer requests, specifications, or needs, using telephones and dispatch software. Communicates all pertinent data (customer's locations, type of pickup, scanning requirements, temperature requirements, ect.) to vendors at the time of dispatch.
  • Serve as a contact person for all vendors within their route territories and inform them about traffic problems such as construction areas, accidents, congestion, weather conditions, and other hazards.
  • Manage contact with vendors to ensure all routes are covered, as needed.
  • Determine responses needed to effectively and appropriately deal with emergencies, accidents, and breakdowns.
  • Communicate Chain of Custody standards (location scanning, specimens handling, parcel scanning, etc.) as required by Capstone Logistics customers.
  • Resolve vendor problems or grievances and refer to vendor management, if further assistance is needed.
  • Evaluate importance of incoming telephone calls and prioritize accordingly.
  • Provide support to the customer service team, on an as needed basis or during peak season.
  • Ensure that the policies and procedures, as defined in the Independent Contractor Operating Agreement, are consistently followed.
  • Makes decisions and takes the necessary actions to determine the most appropriate delivery methods to meet or exceed the customer's service expectations.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, on the status of each job within the dispatch POD, manages distribution of work, and ensures documentation is complete before jobs are cleared.

Customer Service:

  • Provide excellent customer service by ensuring timely and efficient courier service for customers according to route schedules and On Demand requests.
  • Confer with customers or supervising personnel in order to address questions, problems, complaints, and requests for service.
  • Keep customers notified of changes with route schedules and or on demand delays.

Requirements:

  • Excellent verbal communication and problem solving skills
  • Computer skills including Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Internet.
  • Interpersonal skills; ability to foster teamwork and motivate/coach others.
  • Knowledge of local and regional geographical area
  • Accurately and quickly read maps
  • Make optimum decisions under pressure and time constraints

title: Project Manager
description:
Capstone Logistics is seeking a Project Manager to lead cross-functional site startup and go-live initiatives. This role coordinates execution across Operations, IT, Finance, HR/HRIS, Payroll, Data & Reporting, Service Desk, Telecommunications, and other enabling teams to ensure successful site activation and stabilization.

The Project Manager owns the project plan, timeline, risks and issues, and go-live readiness, driving alignment from planning through post–go-live transition. The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented leader who excels at coordinating complex initiatives and guiding cross-functional teams to successful outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, results-driven collaborator who can guide a team of subject matter experts to success in a high-impact, visible role.

Project Manager Responsibilities:

  • Confirm site startup schedule, scope, and site list (e.g., partner/site type, services to be enabled, pilot exclusions, and go-live date).
  • Gather and validate required site leadership and contacts (Site Manager/Director/VP/SVP) to prevent workflow validation errors and misrouted access requests.
  • Develop and maintain an end-to-end startup plan (milestones, dependencies, owners, due dates) and communicate the critical path.
  • Establish governance cadence (weekly stakeholder calls; daily huddles as go-live approaches) and document decisions and action items.
  • Submit and manage the site startup request; ensure required data and attachments (pricing, site details, headcount, hours of operation, connectivity requirements) are complete and accurate.
  • Monitor auto-generated tasks, confirm they are applicable, and coordinate execution with the responsible teams; document exemptions where tasks are not required.
  • Identify risks, constraints, and dependencies (e.g., approvals, system lead times, integration readiness), maintain a RAID log, and drive mitigation/contingency plans.
  • Coordinate setup and validation across core systems (e.g., site creation/configuration, access provisioning, and role setup) in alignment with the selected startup scenario.
  • Coordinate IT hardware and asset readiness (ordering, configuration, shipping, and on-site delivery where needed) and confirm inventory requirements.
  • Coordinate telecommunications and connectivity readiness (e.g., dedicated internet/phone, routers/MiFi where applicable, connectivity validation/speed tests, and VPN/access standards).
  • Coordinate reporting platform readiness: confirm site mapping/codes, ensure site availability in reporting, and validate role-based access (e.g., limited vs. full reporting access by role).
  • Coordinate financial system setup and banking prerequisites as applicable (e.g., new site setup activities and required assignments).
  • Define go-live readiness criteria and run a final readiness review: confirm all required tasks are complete, tested, and signed off (or formally exempted).
  • Manage go-live support period: lead issue triage, coordinate fixes/workarounds, and provide frequent status updates to stakeholders.
  • Establish post-startup governance (weekly recurring check-ins) to resolve access, reporting, and operational gaps during stabilization.
  • Document lessons learned and transition open items to steady-state owners (KTLO/support teams) with clear handoffs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Quickly understands operational, technical, and organizational requirements associated with new site implementations and system integrations
  • Serves as the central point of coordination for cross-functional implementation efforts across Operations, IT, Finance, HR/HRIS, Payroll, Data & Reporting, Service Desk, Telecommunications, and other enabling teams
  • Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders to define implementation objectives and align execution plans
  • Conducts stakeholder analysis and establishes appropriate communication and governance structures
  • Develops, maintains, and executes detailed project plans to support site startup, integration build, migration, and go-live activities
  • Identifies cross-team dependencies, risks, and issues; proactively drives mitigation and resolution to ensure timeline adherence
  • Reviews and validates implementation requirements, deployment plans, and go-live readiness criteria
  • Drives execution through go-live, ensuring successful handoff to operational and support teams
  • Prepares and delivers clear, concise status reporting and go-live readiness communications
  • Experience managing projects involving multiple business service lines and third-party vendors
  • Strong working knowledge of project management methodologies and delivery frameworks (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid models)
  • Ability to manage scope, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
  • Strong experience using collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for documentation, communication, and status reporting
  • Demonstrated leadership skills in guiding cross-functional teams through complex implementation efforts
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments with shifting priorities
  • High attention to detail across both strategic planning and tactical execution
  • Ability to balance speed-to-market with disciplined delivery and risk management

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics Management, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field.
  • At least 5 - 7 years of relevant experience in Implementation project management OR
  • Relevant combination of education and experience
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively (written & oral) and deliver consistently strong, measurable results
  • Strong Smartsheet or MS Project skills, as well as proficiency with the MS Office suite
  • Required: PMP certification/ CSM or PSM certifications and formal training in negotiation/facilitation skills
  • Preferred: 3-5 years of demonstrated experience in logistics industry or similar

COMPETENCIES:

  • Self-starter that learns quickly, takes ownership, and can navigate a fast-paced environment
  • Detail orientated with a drive to execute tasks and deliver high-quality work
  • Ability to develop and deliver multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding to a variety of audiences
  • Highly organized, strategic, and creative personality with strong business acumen
  • Anticipates and balances the needs of multiple stakeholders
  • Strong problem solving, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Must demonstrate integrity, enthusiasm, and initiative in their daily work

title: Senior Test Technician (2nd shift 1:00pm-10:30pm)
description:
Mercury Systems is seeking the best and brightest talent to help us bring cutting-edge technology to mission-critical aerospace and defense applications, advancing innovation where it matters most. In this role, Mercury Systems seeks a Senior Test Technician to test and troubleshoot state-of-the-art, complex digital system assemblies in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

You are an extension of the Test Engineering team responsible for ensuring the proper operation and functionality of advanced technological products that have a real-world impact in one of the fastest-growing companies in the US. This position is for a seasoned individual contributor in the Test sub-family, working under limited supervision in routine and defined situations.

This is a First shift position. 2nd shift hours are 1:00 pm - 10:30 pm M-TH and 1:00 pm -9:30 pm every other Friday on a 9/80 schedule.

Job Summary: Sr Test Technician-MFTTS3

Test and troubleshoot state-of-the-art complex digital system assemblies in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. You are a part of the Test Engineering group responsible for ensuring the proper operation and functionality of advanced technological products that have a real-world impact in one of the fastest-growing companies in the US. This position is for a seasoned individual contributor in the Test sub-family, working under limited supervision in routine and defined situations.

Job Responsibility:

  • The candidate must be able to apply electronics principles in the test and troubleshooting of high-density multi-system (multiple CPU/FPGA) assemblies, at the board and system level.
  • The Test Technician will perform functional test procedures that verify PCB and system fit, form, and functionality. This includes, but is not limited to, the following:
  • Applying methods and techniques for effectively monitoring various diagnostics tests and measuring performance on complex systems.
  • Selection, set up, and deployment of complex and specialized equipment/facilities over a broad spectrum of technologies.
  • Verification and validation of product configuration, test processes and test equipment/setup configuration and operation.
  • Measuring, collecting, and recording of performance data that verifies the reliability and validity of the desired function; prepare accurate and complete test reports of all recorded data.
  • Programming and verification of devices.
  • Troubleshooting of systems, devices, processes and/or test set-ups to locate and repair defective areas.
  • Assisting engineers in submission of processes and operations that assure proper function of product and test equipment per design specifications by working from general block diagrams, rough outlines of basic circuits, oral instructions, schematics, etc.; making necessary calculations to obtain or compare data as required.
  • Performing initial procedural tests on new and/or changed equipment; submitting recommendations for modifications as required to achieve desired results.
  • Submission of defects reporting, non-conforming materials reports, and communication with the production team in the resolution of defects/product failures.
  • Any other task assigned by the supervisor.

Required Qualification:

  • Performs complex testing and moderate problem-solving on digital systems and subassemblies. Has a solid understanding of manufacturing quality standards and can read schematics or other technical data as needed. Ability to prepare complex test reports and data in accordance with functional and acceptance level test procedures, may be requested to assist with red-lining of existing functional testing procedures. Performs complex testing; Thermal, Shock, Vibration and Environmental Tests. Troubleshoots and is able to determine the root cause of issues with assemblies, debugging of moderate to complex problems. Uses a variety of test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multi-meters, serial emulators, networking devices, and other tools found in a testing laboratory to ensure the highest quality of integrated and tested products.
  • Ability to work with little to no general direction.
  • Excellent Teamwork and Communications Skills: Ability to work with others in a team environment to meet deadlines and complete tasks in a timely manner. Ideal candidates will have the ability to communicate with other team members and associated parties in a thorough and timely manner.
  • Engineering & Design: Knowledge of practical applications of engineering and technology, able to apply principles, techniques, and procedures to manufacturing processes, knowledge of design techniques and principals involved in manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing efficiency within manufacturing. Ability to read and perform test procedures and communicate effectively in the event of potential issues.
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving: Ability to determine root cause(s) of operating errors and methodologies used to resolve them; ability to apply logic and reason to identify complex problems and develop solutions, ability to predict how changes in operations and process flow will affect manufacturing efficiencies and quality of finished product.
  • Electronics Troubleshooting/Debugging Knowledge: Ability to read and interpret complex schematics and functional/diagnostic specifications for determining the root cause of failures in the test environment.
  • Training: Able to maintain training on applicable equipment and procedures as assigned per job title.
  • Exceptional Computer Skills: Basic Microsoft Office suite skills are a must. A successful candidate should have a broad understanding of computer systems, including a basic understanding of TCP/IP, serial communications, RDP use, Linux, and basic command structure, and a rudimentary ability to interpret and modify plain-text scripts as needed. Factory Logix, Oracle, Xilinx Suites, Dediprog, ProComm, SecureCRT, and TeraTerm application knowledge is a plus.

Preferred Qualification:

  • High school Diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience 3 - 5 years
  • Factory Logix, Oracle, Xilinx Suites, Dediprog, ProComm, SecureCRT, TeraTerm application knowledge is a plus.

title: Structural Engineering Intern (Utilities)
description:

title: Client Services and Operations Assistant (Real Estate, Singapore)
description:
Full-time · Singapore · S$4,000–S$5,000 gross monthly, depending on relevant experience, plus performance incentives. Applicable employer CPF is additional; incentive terms will be explained before an offer is accepted.

Who This Is For

You like keeping things moving. Ten small things in the air, none dropped. You are happy on the phone with a tenant at 10, at a showflat at 12, and back at a laptop at 3 with a tidy list of what is done and what needs a decision. You notice the detail nobody asked you to notice, and you would rather fix the process than repeat the fix.

Bring relevant experience in executive assistance, property administration, client services or similar operations work, with examples of dependable follow-through. We provide training in our property workflows.

What We Are

A small property advisory practice led by Daniel Ong, a real estate advisor with PropNex. You keep his week organised, clients looked after and paperwork moving, working directly with one decision-maker. Content production sits with a separate hire. You coordinate directly with that colleague on approved shoots, access and events; Daniel sets priorities.

What You Would Actually Do

1. Keep the week running. His calendar, appointments, routes and confirmations. Keep one live list of deadlines, next steps and decisions waiting on him.

2. Look after client and tenant administration. Coordinate viewing appointments, support advisor-led handovers, organise keys and contractors, track repairs, servicing receipts and rent reminders, and prepare approved PropertyGuru listing materials. You are a friendly, organised point of contact for scheduling and routine updates.

3. Keep the paperwork straight. Prepare tenancy agreements from approved templates and verified instructions, assemble transaction packs, maintain expense records and coordinate events. Daniel determines terms, approves documents before circulation and makes agency submissions. You track deadlines, chase missing items and flag decisions needed.

What This Is Not

- Not a desk-only job: about half your week is out with him or at properties across the island.

- Not a sales role: This is an administrative support role. Daniel conducts property viewings and handles property advice, transaction introductions and negotiations. You identify yourself as his assistant and refer these matters to him. You keep everything around them moving.

- Not a job for someone who needs every step assigned: once you know a case, you run its routine yourself.

- Not a household manager: there is a little agreed personal admin, and that is where it ends.

See Who You Would Work With

Before you apply, look at Daniel's personal brand at https://www.instagram.com/danielongwl/ and the business brand at https://www.instagram.com/gableandroof.sg/ and https://gableandroof.sg/. This is the work your support would help him develop.

How We Work

Monday–Friday, 9:30am–6:30pm with a one-hour lunch break; Weekends are normally off. Occasional Saturday work is required with advance notice, with time off in lieu provided. If an office is established, designated office days may be introduced with advance notice.

No standing requirement to monitor messages outside working hours. Work phone and SIM provided.

The first three months include training, case briefings, checklists and templates as you progressively own routine administration. You can implement agreed process improvements; workload and priorities are reviewed together.

How To Apply

Write us a short message, not a cover letter. Put the word "keys" in your first line so we know you read this far. Then three quick things: the thing you have organised that you are proudest of, what you have done so far that makes you think you can do this job, and your favourite task management tool with the two features you actually use.

Strong bonus, if you want to stand out: tell us in five sentences about a time you untangled a scheduling mess, or send a two-minute video introducing yourself.

Shortlisted candidates get the full role document before the interview, so there are no surprises.

description:
Job Summary:

Mechanical Assembler.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Follow production schedules, traveler documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Perform rework or touch-up operations to correct coating issues without damaging the PCB or components.
  • Ensure all handling and processing of coatings and/or other material comply with safety guidelines, PPE requirements, and chemical handling policies.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying process issues, suggesting improvements, and assisting in process validations when required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Typically requires one year of experience or less.
  • Ability to work under a microscope for long periods of time.
  • Must have meticulous hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.
  • Must be detailed oriented and able to multitask.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • OT is available & encouraged.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of IPC-610 standards.
  • 1+ years in a Mechanical Assembly position or similar position.
  • Experience in electronics manufacturing or PCB assembly preferred.
  • Knowledge of ESD (Electrostatic discharge) procedures.

title: Head of Brand Communications, SEAA
description:
At CHANEL, we are anchored in our brand culture, codes and values, with a clear vision and aligned priorities centered around being a human and purposeful employer. We are focused on supporting the needs of CHANEL creation, people and business, while bringing positive impact to the world and preparing the organization for the future. We have a culture of high-performance standards and excellence, with people at their best in an environment where they feel belonging and purpose.

The Communications & Culture function’s mandate is to nurture long-term brand equity, amplify the unique CHANEL identity, and forge meaningful connections across communities, industries and cultures.

The Head of Brand Communications, SEAA is the regional architect and guardian of CHANEL’s One House brand narrative across Southeast Asia and Australia. This senior role leads the regional Brand Communications Centre of Excellence across Brand Transmission and Culture, ensuring CHANEL’s singularity, values and cultural authority are expressed consistently and meaningfully across internal and external audiences.

This role is designed to provide long-term strategic communications planning, future influence audience prioritization, One House narrative development, cultural intelligence, community-building frameworks, regional amplification and capability building.

Working closely with Global, regional divisions, market Communications & Culture leads, People & Organisation, and strategic external partners, this role translates global brand priorities into SEAA-relevant strategies and elevates local insights into regional and global influence.

WHAT IMPACT YOU CAN CREATE AT CHANEL

One House Brand Narrative & Brand Desirability

  • Define and lead the regional Brand Communications strategy and multi-year roadmap for SEAA, connecting divisional activities with One House brand ambitions.

  • Develop the narrative architecture, messaging frameworks and editorial priorities required to express CHANEL’s singularity beyond product launches and campaigns.

  • Shape coherent regional priorities around Brand Transmission, Women of Influence, Arts & Culture, leadership moments and other One House brand-building platforms.

  • Ensure brand storytelling strengthens long-term desirability, cultural relevance and advocacy across diverse SEAA audiences.

Brand Transmission & Internal / External Advocacy

  • Own the regional Brand Transmission strategy, framework and standards, ensuring consistent understanding and expression of CHANEL’s values across markets.

  • Partner with People & Organisation and market teams to strengthen employee brand advocacy, brand intuition and internal pride.

  • Create tools, content and engagement platforms that enable employees and partners to become stronger ambassadors of the House.

  • Connect internal culture-building with external brand storytelling so that every audience touchpoint reflects a coherent and compelling brand experience.

Arts & Culture and Cultural Intelligence

  • In collaboration with Global, to lead the regional Arts & Culture strategy and framework, including partnership principles, activation guardrails and strategic territories for SEAA.

  • Build cultural intelligence capability that tracks emerging cultural shifts, anticipates future influence networks and translates insights into brand strategy.

  • Support markets in identifying cultural opportunities and creative communities that have regional relevance.

  • Position CHANEL as an active participant in shaping culture across SEAA.

Influence Ecosystem Mapping & Community Building

  • Map regional communities of influence across female leadership, creative communities, cultural institutions, entrepreneurs, academics, filmmakers, artists and thought leaders.

  • Define priority audience segments for the future while enabling markets to identify and cultivate the right local individuals and partners.

  • Create scalable community-building frameworks for platforms such as Women of Influence, Arts & Culture partnerships and soft-power conversations.

  • Amplify successful market initiatives regionally and connect local communities to broader SEAA and global opportunities.

Regional Centre of Excellence, Capability Building & Knowledge Management

  • Build the regional playbooks, toolkits, benchmarks and best practices that markets can adapt locally

  • Establish communities of practice, workshops and learning modules that raise market capability in Brand Transmission, cultural intelligence, influence, Arts & Culture and narrative development

  • Develop capability development pathways that strengthen the long-term Communications & Culture talent pipeline across markets and region

Global-Regional-Market Alignment

  • Represent SEAA as a distinct region in global communications and brand forums, ensuring Southeast Asian and Australian market nuances inform global decisions.

  • Translate global priorities such as women’s impact, cultural authority and Freedom of Becoming into SEAA-relevant frameworks that markets can localize.

  • Escalate regional opportunities and risks to Global where they have broader relevance.

  • Strengthen the operating rhythm between Global, Region and Markets so that markets create relevance and the region creates leverage.

YOU ARE ENERGISED BY

  • Building long-term brand desirability through a deeper One House brand narrative, cultural authority and meaningful advocacy.

  • Turning cultural intelligence into strategic choices that shape where CHANEL should engage, invest and lead.

  • Connecting diverse markets around shared frameworks while respecting local nuance, maturity and relationships.

  • Developing communities of influence across arts, culture, creativity, women’s leadership, entrepreneurship and thought leadership.

  • Elevating market capability through coaching, playbooks, communities of practice and practical tools that teams can use.

  • Working in a matrixed, multi-market environment where influence, partnership and clarity are critical to impact.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 12 to 15+ years of progressive experience in brand communications, corporate communications, cultural strategy, reputation management, luxury communications, public relations or related fields.

  • Proven ability to shape brand narratives, editorial frameworks and long-term communications roadmaps across multiple markets.

  • Deep understanding of brand desirability, cultural relevance, community building and influence ecosystems, preferably within luxury, fashion, beauty, arts or culture-led sectors.

  • Strong strategic planning capability, with the ability to translate insights, market intelligence and cultural shifts into actionable communications priorities.

  • Experience developing frameworks, playbooks, governance models, toolkits or capability-building programs for regional or multi-market teams.

  • Strong cultural intelligence and sensitivity to the diversity of SEAA markets, including differences in markets’ maturity, audience behaviour, influence dynamics and stakeholder ecosystems.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Global, regional divisions, market leaders, People & Organisation and external partners.

  • Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills in English; additional SEAA market language capability is an advantage.

  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial and highly organized leadership style, with the ability to move between strategic vision and practical execution.

WHAT THE ROLE CAN OFFER YOU

  • A dynamic, creative and inclusive environment where you can make a real impact on brand, people and culture.

  • The opportunity to shape a strategic regional Centre of Excellence and strengthen CHANEL’s long-term brand desirability across SEAA.

  • The opportunity to work across Global, Region, Divisions and Markets on meaningful initiatives spanning Brand Transmission, Arts & Culture, Women of Influence, leadership communications and community building.

  • Exposure to diverse markets, cultural contexts and communities across Southeast Asia and Australia.

  • The opportunity to learn and grow with CHANEL, with more than 100 years of heritage, and be inspired and nurtured through every encounter you experience.

KEY MEASUREMENT OF IMPACT

  • A clear One House brand narrative and Brand Transmission framework is defined, adopted and consistently localized across SEAA markets.

  • SEAA markets demonstrate stronger capability maturity in Brand Transmission, Arts & Culture, cultural intelligence, influence ecosystem mapping and narrative development.

  • SEAA established as a distinct region, with market nuances and regional priorities reflected in global communications agendas.

  • Successful market initiatives are documented, scaled and amplified regionally, creating greater leverage without centralizing local execution.

  • Stronger engagement with priority communities of influence, including creative, cultural, women’s leadership and thought-leadership communities.

  • Improved efficiency and clarity in ways of working between Global, Region, Divisions and Markets, with reduced duplication and clearer ownership.

  • Stakeholders report stronger strategic partnership quality, responsiveness and value from the regional Communications & Culture function.

At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

About Us

Chanel is a world leader in creating, manufacturing and distributing luxury products, including Ready-to-Wear, Accessories, Fragrances, Makeup, Skincare, Jewellery and Watches. Founded by Gabrielle Chanel in 1910, the House remains dedicated to quality craftsmanship and offering high-end creations. At present, Chanel employs more than 32,000 people worldwide.

As an independent company, its core values are grounded in:

  • Exceptional creation and client experience

  • Nurturing human potential

  • Having a positive impact – on people, the environment and communities around the world.

As part of this, the House promotes arts, culture and creativity, while investing significantly in key areas including research & development, sustainability, and innovation.

Chanel is dedicated to creating the conditions for people to perform at their best, building on their strengths and enabling them to benefit from new opportunities. It offers a unique working environment where people are given time to understand the brand, the business, and develop their personal motivations. This means everyone can grow, continue to be inspired and feel included, now and in the future. The company fosters true collaboration and respect for all, grounded in the belief that diversity is essential to the success of the organisation and its people.

Chanel remains committed to rewarding people competitively, as well as offering initiatives such as wellbeing programmes, learning and development opportunities, and parental leave for all parents globally.

title: Principal Electrical Engineer - (board level design)
description:
Job Summary:

Mercury Systems offers Principal Electrical Engineers a fulfilling career where you will see the direct impact of your board designs in deployed systems with true end-to-end ownership. You're not just implementing requirements; you're architecting ruggedized circuit board solutions that must perform under extreme conditions in real-world defense and aerospace applications. You will lead board-level hardware development for mission-critical embedded computing, high-speed digital systems, advanced FPGA solutions, secure processing, and extreme environment electronics supporting operations across air, land, sea, and space.

We emphasize design quality through collaborative reviews and proactive verification, helping teams deliver reliable solutions efficiently. You will shape the organization's technical direction, establish engineering standards, and drive innovation for high-reliability defense and aerospace applications. At Mercury, we work with an Integrator Mindset, collaborating across sites and disciplines to create board-level solutions that directly impact our country's security.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead board-level design and development of complex digital circuits and modules from concept through production
  • Architect advanced electrical circuit board solutions involving secure processing, storage, networking, FPGAs, high-speed interfaces, and extreme environment electronics
  • Develop high-speed digital board designs including 400G+ Ethernet, PCIe Gen5+, DDR5+, and advanced interconnects
  • Establish engineering best practices, board design guidelines, and quality-focused processes that promote proactive verification
  • Support proposal development with technical architecting, cost/schedule estimates, and BOE
  • Drive board manufacturability (DFM/DFA/DFT) and collaborate with manufacturing on build issues

Required Qualifications:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • Typically requires 6+ years of electrical engineering experience in board-level hardware design from concept through production
  • Experience designing complex embedded digital hardware with high-speed interfaces, memory technologies, and next-generation interconnects
  • Strong understanding of signal integrity
  • The ability to obtain a DoD Secret Clearance. U.S. Citizenship is required.

Preferred Experience:

Strong candidates typically have experience in several of the following areas:

Digital & High-Speed Technologies

  • Intel or other advanced CPU architectures (Xeon-D, Cascade Lake, Granite Rapids)
  • Advanced FPGA board technologies (AMD/Xilinx Versal, Intel/Altera Agilex)
  • High-speed board interfaces (400G+ Ethernet, PCIe Gen5+, DDR5+)
  • Advanced network interface board designs (Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell)

DoD/Aerospace & Rugged Systems

  • VPX/VITA board standards (3U/6U), COM Express, or SoM architectures
  • MIL-STD board development in rugged environments
  • Secure processing, anti-tamper, or DRFM board designs
  • Space electronics or radiation-tolerant component integration

Tools & Analysis

  • Cadence schematic capture tools (DEHDL/Concept) or equivalent
  • Cadence Allegro or equivalent CAD/SI tools
  • Reliability/stress analysis (FMECA, derating)
  • Requirements and workflow tools (DOORS, JAMA, JIRA, Confluence)

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical teams
  • Experience supporting proposals, cost/schedule estimates, and BOE development

Location:

    • Torrance, CA
    • Cypress, CA
    • Phoenix, AZ

title: AI & Data Engineer
description:
In response to the expansion into new emerging areas in recent years, the ASTM Advanced Manufacturing Center of Excellence (AM CoE) is exploring the convergence of Additive Manufacturing and other emerging technologies such as Robotics, automation and autonomous system, Artificial intelligence and Machine learning (AI & ML) targeting towards applications in Advanced Manufacturing.
Through collaboration among industry, government, and academia, ASTM AM CoE addresses not only the need for accelerated standards development models to help qualify these growing markets but also the personnel training and certification programs needed for those now tasked with a more diverse set of responsibilities.
The AM CoE conducts R&D projects, technology road mapping sessions, strategic guidance reports as well as landscape analysis to help organizations adopt AM and other Advanced Manufacturing technologies. Some of these projects are a result of cross-continent efforts coordinated and supported by the AM CoE.We are seeking a AI & Data Engineer to join the AM CoE's Market Intelligence team in Singapore. The AI & Data Engineer will design, build, and maintain AI and data tools that support the team's research and analysis, help automate the production of intelligence deliverables, and power AI features on the team's digital platform. The role works closely with technical experts to ensure outputs are accurate and reliable.
Specifically, the AI & Data Engineer will:

  • Build and maintain AI/LLM tools and data pipelines that process large documents and datasets into structured, usable analysis
  • Develop and support AI features on the team's digital platform, including a research/search assistant
  • Help automate the production of recurring research and intelligence deliverables to improve efficiency and quality
  • Build reusable tools and workflows that can be applied across multiple subject areas
  • Implement appropriate controls for quality, cost, and data governance
  • Work with technical experts to review and validate AI-generated output for accuracy
  • Support integration with external vendors and internal technology review processes as required
Please note that limited travel may be required for this position (up to 20%).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience building applications with large language models and modern AI/ML frameworks
  • Strong programming skills (e.g., Python) and experience with APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and evaluation of model outputs
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to meet project timelines
  • Willing to learn and adapt with emerging technologies
  • Proven ability to work in a team with good interpersonal skills
  • Self-starter with exceptional attention to detail
  • Technically motivated to solve problems and have the creativity to initiate new ideas
  • Can-do attitude and independent decision-making abilities
  • Passion for innovation, technology, and enterprise development
  • Proven record of analytical thinking and problem solving

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience building and deploying AI/LLM-based systems in production
  • Experience with data engineering including but not limited to building and maintaining data pipelines and structured datasets
  • Experience automating document-heavy or research and analysis workflows
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including using project management tools to improve productivity
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively with all levels of management and translate them into meaningful project outcomes

About ASTM International

ASTM International is an international standards organization that develops and publishes voluntary consensus technical standards for a wide range of materials, products, systems, and services. Approximately 12,575 ASTM voluntary consensus standards operate globally. Defined and set by ASTM, these standards improve the lives of millions every day. Combined with our innovative business services, they enhance performance and help people around the world have confidence in the things they buy and use. The organization's headquarters is in West Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, about 5 mi (8.0 km) northwest of Philadelphia. Founded in 1898 as the American Section of the International Association for Testing Materials, ASTM International predates other standards organizations such as the BSI (1901), IEC (1906), DIN (1917), ANSI (1918), AFNOR (1926), and ISO (1947).

About ASTM AM CoE

In March 2018, ASTM International—together with its partners Auburn University, NASA, and EWI—launched the ASTM AM CoE; they were quickly joined in May 2018 by the UK Manufacturing Technology Center (MTC), furthering the CoE's international footprint and complementing its capabilities. In August 2018, NIAR joined the CoE as its first Strategic Partner. ASTM AM CoE's founding partners' mandate, in conjunction with various industrial partners, is to establish industry-specific additive manufacturing standardization, as well as qualification and certification practices, to accelerate and close standard gaps identified in the industry's leading roadmaps (e.g., AMSC roadmap). Leveraging the resources of ASTM AM CoE, ASTM seeks to enhance and refine developed technologies by fostering new collaborations with industry and other government agencies. In tandem with these efforts, ASTM AM CoE also acts as a liaison between industry/government/academia and the standards development community to ensure that technologies are standardized to have the greatest impact on the economy and manufacturing sector while also meeting the needs of industrial and government stakeholders.

title: Agentic AI Engineer (Life Sciences & Knowledge Graphs)
description:
Agentic AI Engineer (Life Sciences & Knowledge Graphs)

Contract · EU-Remote


Want to build AI agents that actually give trustworthy, explainable answers not confident guesses? This is a role for a GenAI engineer who knows that the way you get there is by grounding LLMs in real, governed enterprise knowledge.


You'll join a specialist team at a global life-sciences organisation building a new generation of knowledge-graph-powered AI agents. Your focus is the tooling and the applications on top of the intelligence layer, not the underlying data.


What you'll build


Picture an agent that answers a question like “which priority hospitals in the US have decreasing sales?” To do it, the agent reads the definitions of the business terms from a knowledge graph so it understands the question, then queries the data warehouse for the real figures, and composes a grounded, traceable answer.


That grounding is the whole point: it's what cuts hallucination and makes every answer explainable. If building that kind of system sounds like your idea of a good problem, read on.


What you'll do:


  • Design and build LLM-powered agents and retrieval solutions on top of enterprise knowledge and data
  • Connect agents to enterprise systems through tool definitions and MCP-style connections
  • Benchmark and evaluate models, then take solutions from prototype into production
  • Build reusable frameworks and accelerators for agentic AI
  • Define the testing, evaluation, monitoring and governance for what you ship


What you'll bring (essential)


  • Strong hands-on GenAI / LLM engineering - you've built real solutions with LLMs: agents, RAG, prompt and tool design, benchmarking, and shipping to production


  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs and semantic web in applications - SPARQL, RDF and related standards


  • Strong Python and modern API development


  • Solid software engineering fundamentals — Git, CI/CD, testing, cloud-native architecture


  • A clear communicator who works well with both technical and business stakeholders


4+ years of AI engineering experience is a starting point — we care far more about genuine depth building LLM-powered systems than years on paper.


Nice to have


  • MCP (very learnable if you know LLMs and Python)
  • Vector databases, embeddings and semantic search
  • Any graph or semantic tooling — Neo4j, Stardog, metaphactory, Snowflake and similar (current set up is standards-based and vendor-neutral, so the standards matter more than any one product)
  • Life sciences, pharma or other regulated-industry experience


The details


  • Contract role
  • EU-remote based
  • Occasional on-site workshops in Germany (roughly every couple of months)
  • Start: 1st October
  • Runs to year-end initially, with strong potential to extend into a full project in the new year


Please hit the apply button if you are Interested

title: Data Engineer, Data Practice
description:
The Government Technology Agency (GovTech) is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity. At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better. We empower our people to master their craft through continuous and robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Our GovTechies embody our Agile, Bold and Collaborative values to deliver impactful solutions. GovTech aims to transform the delivery of Government digital services by taking an "outside-in" view, putting citizens and businesses at the heart of everything we do. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg

GovTech Data Practice

The Data Practice drives innovation and sets best practices for the effective and responsible use of data across the Whole-of-Government (WOG). We work at the intersection of data engineering, AI, privacy, and governance - developing standards, platforms, and tools that enable agencies to build high-quality data products and unlock the value of data for public good.

Today, most organisations still struggle with data that is fragmented, inconsistent, and hard to use, alongside AI that is powerful but brittle without strong data foundations, and privacy policies that are difficult to operationalise. We are changing that at a national scale.

We are reimagining data engineering itself through AI for Data Engineering (AIDE), which introduces self‑improving data pipelines that detect, fix, and optimise themselves, AI‑assisted data modelling and quality management at scale, and semantic, context‑aware data layers that make data instantly usable for AI. Underpinned by standardised, AI‑native architectures, this ensures every agency can build strong foundations from day one.

At the same time, a Trusted Data Nation only works if data can be used without compromising privacy or security. We operationalise Privacy‑Enhancing Technologies (PETs) into real capabilities, including federated computing to unlock insights without moving data, differential privacy and synthetic data to enable safe sharing, and trusted execution environments to compute on sensitive data securely. Alongside this, we build the golden paths for Singapore by creating reference architectures, reusable components, standard data platforms, and engineering playbooks that scale quality across government.

What you will be working on

You Will Be Involved In

  • Experimentation and exploration
  • Explore AI possibilities that can supercharge data engineering processes.

  • Make what is possible accessible to all, driving impact across government and beyond Singapore.

  • Design and execute pilots at agencies to test prototype solutions
  • Systematically gather user feedback and iterate on solutions based on practical deployment experiences and lessons learned
  • Provide ongoing technical consultation and hands‑on support to agencies
  • End‑to‑end Solution Innovation & Development
  • Identify opportunities where exploratory technologies can address current common data challenges across government
  • Architect and develop scalable solutions designed for widespread adoption across the Whole of Government ecosystem
  • Establish clear implementation pathways and adoption frameworks for new technologies
  • Cross‑functional Collaboration
  • Work as a collaborative team player alongside fellow data engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and product managers
  • Partner strategically with government agencies to align technical solutions with the evolving landscape of regulatory requirements and governance frameworks
  • Strategic Direction & Technical Leadership (for more senior hires)
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and their relevance for government use cases
  • Shape the team’s direction by defining high‑impact problem areas and prioritising initiatives
  • Scope and drive projects end‑to‑end, from early exploration through to scaled deployment across agencies
  • Engage stakeholders across policy, engineering, and vendors to align on problem framing and solution design
  • Mentor team members and contribute to building a strong, high‑performing team

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics or a related field, with at least 5-8 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates will be assessed based on their experience and may be considered at the intermediate or senior level.
  • Core Data Engineering skillset
  • Deep understanding of system design, data structure and algorithms, data modelling, data access, and data storage.
  • Demonstrated ability in using cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Prior experience
  • Experience in architecting data and IT systems.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with analytical data warehouses
  • Strong Python engineering skills
  • Experience working with LLM APIs or AI‑assisted engineering workflows
  • Prior experience working in multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Mindset & Collaboration
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new domains
  • Inclination to work in a collaborative, fast‑moving Agile environment.
  • Strong in communication with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audience

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

description:
SUMMARY OF ROLE

The Supervisor – Investment Back Office is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Investment Back Office (IBO), ensuring accurate processing, reconciliation, and reporting of investment transactions across local, regional, and international markets. The role ensures adherence to internal controls, regulatory requirements, and service level agreements while maintaining high standards of operational efficiency, risk management, and customer service. The role also focuses on strengthening operational controls, enhancing MIS capabilities, supporting new business initiatives (including IPOs and investment products), and leading the team to deliver seamless support to Investment Banking Division (IBD) and external clients.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Investment Operations & Processing

  • Oversee and ensure accurate and timely processing of all investment transactions, including brokerage, asset management, wealth management (discretionary and non-discretionary), and proprietary portfolio activities.
  • Manage processing activities related to IPO subscriptions, corporate actions, and new investment business initiatives.
  • Ensure adherence to defined SLAs and maintain high-quality service delivery to internal stakeholders and external clients.
  • Monitor transaction workflows to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timely execution.


Reconciliation & Accounting Control

  • Perform and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of bank statements, investment accounts, and General Ledger (GL) balances.
  • Ensure all internal accounts are accurately maintained, reviewed, and reconciled on a regular basis.
  • Investigate reconciliation breaks and discrepancies, identify root causes, and ensure timely resolution in coordination with Finance, IT, and other relevant departments.
  • Ensure proper accounting treatment and accurate booking of all investment-related transactions.


Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards, maintaining zero tolerance for high-risk or repeat audit findings.
  • Conduct proactive risk assessments and define Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to identify and mitigate potential operational risks.
  • Escalate exceptions, incidents, and control breaches in a timely manner and ensure proper documentation and resolution.
  • Ensure timely closure of audit findings and maintain strong control frameworks within the unit.


MIS, Reporting & Regulatory Submissions

  • Ensure accuracy and timeliness of MIS reports, regulatory returns, and customer reports submitted to stakeholders and regulatory authorities.
  • Develop and enhance reporting dashboards to track volumes, productivity, error rates, and operational performance.
  • Provide periodic reports (daily, weekly, monthly) on operational performance, risk indicators, and control effectiveness.
  • Support management decision-making through data-driven insights and reporting.


Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with Investment Banking Division (IBD), internal departments, and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a key point of contact for operational support, issue resolution, and service delivery coordination.
  • Ensure a partnership approach with business units through effective communication and SLA adherence.


Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Investment Operations, Custody, or Banking Operations.

You'll also participate in safety initiatives, identifying and helping remediate potential risks while fostering a strong safety culture across the facility. Your work directly impacts the reliability and performance of our global infrastructure.

Our mission is to ensure that the systems supporting millions of users operate reliably and efficiently. We work collaboratively across multiple disciplines—electrical, mechanical, and control systems to solve complex operational challenges. title: RF Test Technician - DoD SkillBridge

description:
This position is reserved for Active Military Personnel looking for internships through the DoD SkillBridge program. If you are not currently serving, please see our website for other opportunities not marked SkillBridge.

Mercury is proud to offer this opportunity to active US military service members as a SkillBridge internship position. Mercury SkillBridge is open to all ranks and experience levels provided they meet the minimum requirements for the position listed below. SkillBridge participants are not eligible for compensation from Mercury, as they continue to receive military compensation and benefits as Active-duty service members. For full SkillBridge eligibility please visit the SkillBridge website at

Job Summary:

The RF Test Technician will conduct RF measurements on semiconductor components such as amplifiers, switches, filters, mixers, multi-chip modules, and integrated microwave assemblies that operate from DC to 40 GHz. The Technician will complete tuning and moderate problem solving which will require a understanding of Engineering standards and the ability to comprehend basic block diagrams. In addition, the Technician may be asked prepare test reports and data in accordance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP) and may help write Acceptance Testing Procedures.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Tune, test and troubleshoot microwave components from 20MHz to 40GHz, including but not limited to, filters, mixers, switches, diplexers, multiplexers, filter-LNAs, amplifiers and integrated microwave assemblies (IMAs)
  • Test thermal, shock, vibration and environmental tests, troubleshooting/problem solving, debugging of moderate problems by using a variety of test equipment, including bus analyzers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers to ensure the highest quality of integrated and tested products
  • Perform RF/Microwave related tests utilizing laboratory equipment including network analyzers, signal analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes, function generators, high power amplifiers, noise meters, power meters, and multi-meters
  • Set-up test equipment for testing of production hardware under minimal supervision
  • Work from schematics, work instructions, drawings and operating procedures
  • May assist engineers with new design and development activities including prototyping and first article units
  • Conduct manual and automated production tests on RF semiconductor components
  • Develop an understanding of operation, and parametric behavior of RF components
  • Perform occasional surface mount assembly/rework with hand soldering equipment.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be eligible for a SkillBridge opportunity per DoD guidelines and have prior command approval
  • High School Diploma
  • Typically requires 5+ years' experience in RF and Microwave component testing.
  • Active clearance required day 1.
  • Experience with electrical measurements including but not limited to return loss, insertion loss, rejection, gain, noise figure, 1 dB compression, intermodulation, harmonics, spurious, etc.
  • Experience with DC theory (Ohm's Law).
  • Experience in following test instructions and manufacturing procedures.
  • Experience working under a microscope including excellent hand-eye coordination.
  • Physical hand dexterity to perform all duties needed to complete the work (will require using small hand tools for prolonged periods).
  • Experience Microsoft Office Word and Excel.
  • Experience with electronic circuits fundamentals, and RF measurement methods.
  • Experience using lab test equipment including vector network analyzers, RF signal generators, spectrum analyzers, power meters, digital multi-meters, and basic electronic tools.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Associate Degree in Electronics or military training in RF electronics
  • Understand lumped element, cavity and waveguide filter theory and tuning.
  • Ability to clearly communicate in written and spoken English.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to:

  • Constantly move objects and use abdominal and lower back muscles to provide support over time without fatigue. Specific abilities required by the job include positioning oneself to lift or move objects weighing up to 40lbs.
  • Constant movement and use of limbs. Specific abilities required by this job include prolonged sitting, twisting and working under a microscope for long periods of time will be required. Occasional Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, climbing, and gripping is required daily.
  • Frequently observe, detect, discern, and convey information. Specific abilities required by this job include near, far and color vision acuity, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
  • Requires good manual dexterity, coordination, and stamina. Ability to safely control surgical razor blades and small hand tools used to manipulate tuning stub under a microscope. Specific abilities required by this job include the frequent requirement of overtime work.

This position requires you to have an active government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
location: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description:
We are looking for a motivated and technically strong Senior Cloud Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for a Cloud Engineer who is ready to take the next step in their career by moving from cloud implementation into solution design and architecture.

You will work closely with clients and internal technical teams to understand business requirements, design practical cloud solutions, and support the implementation of scalable, secure, and cost-effective architectures across major cloud platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Client & Requirement Analysis: Work with clients to understand their business and technical requirements and translate them into practical cloud-based solutions.
  • Solution Design: Design and propose cloud architectures based on functional and non-functional requirements, considering scalability, reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Cloud Architecture: Design and implement solutions across cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including enterprise workloads and cloud-native applications.
  • Technical Consultation: Provide technical recommendations and explain proposed solutions to clients and internal stakeholders in a clear and understandable manner.
  • POC & MVP: Support and lead Proof of Concept (POC) and Minimum Viable Product (MVP) initiatives to validate proposed technologies and demonstrate solutions to customers.
  • Solution Specification: Prepare technical specifications, architecture diagrams, implementation approaches, and other documentation required for solution delivery.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Apply IaC practices using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager to ensure consistent and automated infrastructure deployment.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Analyze and resolve complex technical issues across cloud infrastructure and applications, working with engineering teams when required.
  • Automation: Develop automation and scripting using tools or languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash to improve deployment and operational efficiency.
  • Security & Best Practices: Incorporate cloud security, compliance, networking, and operational best practices into proposed solutions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Cloud Engineers, Developers, Project Managers, and other technical teams to ensure the proposed solutions can be implemented successfully.
  • Continuous Learning: Keep up to date with cloud technologies, architecture patterns, DevOps practices, and emerging technologies to continuously improve solution capabilities.

Requirements

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, System Engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Good understanding of cloud architecture concepts, including networking, compute, storage, databases, security, and scalability.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager.
  • Experience with automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, containers, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Ability to analyze technical requirements and translate them into practical solution designs.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to work directly with clients and participate in technical discussions.
  • Important: Only Malaysian Nationality will be proceed

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS Certified (AWS Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps Engineer).
  • Experience with other cloud providers (e.g., Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  • Knowledge of other Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Terragrunt).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies other than Kubernetes (e.g., Docker).

The Applied Machine Learning (AML) team combines system engineering and the art of machine learning to develop and run massively distributed recommendation systems around the world. title: Lead Full Stack - AI Engineer (Relocation to Qatar)
description:
We are seeking a Lead Full Stack AI Engineer to join our team with eventual relocation to Qatar. EPAM is renowned for delivering cutting-edge technological solutions to transform businesses worldwide.

This is an on-site position in Qatar, requiring 3 days per week to be worked at the client's office, and the rest to be worked from anywhere in Qatar. Please only apply if you are willing to relocate to Qatar (and you are eligible). Relocation is supported by the project.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to pragmatic AI architectures (RAG/agents/copilots/automation) integrated into cloud-native microservices and enterprise data platforms
  • Support decisions on when to use RAG vs agents vs conventional approaches
  • Implement and apply spec-driven development (SDD) specs/templates and support governance/quality gates
  • Embed SDD into delivery workflows
  • Build and maintain agentic use cases, including the ability to run/write agents and implement guardrails defined by the program
  • Deliver production solutions (LLM integrations, retrieval, embeddings/vector stores where relevant) embedded into Java/Spring Boot services
  • Implement observability, rollout/versioning, and CI/CD for prompts/specs/models
  • Deploy and operate solutions on AKS and Azure hosting with guidance from platform/SRE teams
  • Contribute to tracking adoption/productivity/quality and risk KPIs for AI-enabled delivery
  • Participate in playbooks, training, documentation, and team mentoring, and share patterns and examples across squads
  • Implement responsible AI controls, data handling constraints, and agent guardrails in line with the client's policies and engineering standards

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on development experience in Core Java, Spring/Spring Boot, web services, and microservices
  • Understanding of cloud-native architecture, database concepts (Oracle/PL/SQL preferred), Kafka, and GitLab
  • 1-2+ years of hands-on delivery exposure to LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems (production or strong pilot/enterprise PoC experience)
  • Understanding of AI concepts, especially Spec Driven Development (SDD), including working knowledge of running and writing agents and implementing guardrails
  • Experience with LLM providers and/or self-hosted models, prompt engineering, and an evaluation/testing mindset
  • Familiarity with Azure, including AKS and/or Azure Web Apps, and CI/CD with GitLab (Azure DevOps a plus)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a global team
  • Practical experience applying SDD (spec-driven ways of working) in a team setting
  • Hands-on experience building and integrating agentic and/or RAG capabilities into real engineering workflows
  • Ability to balance cost, productivity, quality, and risk when implementing LLM/agentic solutions
  • Production mindset, including testing, observability, safe rollout, and secure-by-design implementation

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of React

Benefits

  • Private healthcare and life insurance
  • End of service gratuity
  • Annual air travel tickets for expatriates
  • Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards
  • Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses

title: 1st Shift Mechanical Assembler
description:
Job Responsibilities:

  • Meet daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
  • Communicate effectively to leadership regarding issues/status/performance during a given shift.
  • Maintains an effective relationship with Quality and Engineering teams to ensure production goals are met.
  • Prepares work to be accomplished by studying instructions and following blueprint specifications.
  • Performing a variety of inspections to ensure that it meets/exceeds IPC standards.
  • Performing pass downs with outgoing/incoming shifts.
  • Operate Production equipment (Conformal Coat, Plasma Cleaners, Cure Ovens, etc.).
  • Able to perform all tasks in the Mechanical Assembly operation (Wash, Bake, Underfill, Masking, curing, demasking and cleaning/touch up).
  • Apply underfill and masking material according to specifications and under simulated conditions.
  • Overtime is available and encouraged.
  • Prepare PCBs for coating by masking connectors, components, and keep-out areas according to work instructions and engineering drawings.
  • Apply conformal coatings using automatic coating equipment, Global Precision Dispensing Systems (GPD).
  • Inspect coated assemblies for coverage, thickness, uniformity, and defects using microscopes and other inspection tools.
  • Operate, clean, and maintain conformal coating machines, spray equipment, curing ovens, and related tools.
  • Follow production schedules, traveler documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Perform rework or touch-up operations to correct coating issues without damaging the PCB or components.
  • Ensure all handling and processing of coatings and/or other material comply with safety guidelines, PPE requirements, and chemical handling policies.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying process issues, suggesting improvements, and assisting in process validations when required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Typically requires one year of experience or less.
  • Ability to work under a microscope for long periods of time.
  • Must have meticulous hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.
  • Must be detailed oriented and able to multitask.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • OT is available & encouraged.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of IPC-610 standards.
  • 1+ years in a Mechanical Assembly position or similar position.
  • Experience in electronics manufacturing or PCB assembly preferred.
  • Knowledge of ESD (Electrostatic discharge) procedures.

title: Senior Test Technician
description:
Job Summary:

Test and troubleshoot state-of-the-art complex digital system assemblies in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. You are a part of the Test Engineering group responsible for ensuring the proper operation and functionality of advanced technological products that have a real-world impact in one of the fastest growing companies in the US. This position is for a seasoned individual contributor in the Test sub-family, working under limited supervision in routine and defined situations.

We’re aiming for a November hiring timeline.

Job Responsibilities:

  • The candidate must be able to apply electronics principles in the test and troubleshooting of high-density multi-system (multiple CPU/FPGA) assemblies, at the board and system level.
  • The Test Technician will perform functional test procedures that verify PCB and system fit, form, and functionality. This includes, but is not limited to, the following:
  • Applying methods and techniques for effectively monitoring various diagnostics tests and measuring performance on complex systems.
  • Selection, set up, and deployment of complex and specialized equipment/facilities over a broad spectrum of technologies.
  • Verification and validation of product configuration, test processes and test equipment/setup configuration and operation.
  • Measuring, collecting, and recording of performance data that verifies the reliability and validity of the desired function; prepare accurate and complete test reports of all recorded data.
  • Programming and verification of devices.
  • Troubleshooting of systems, devices, processes and/or test set-ups to locate and repair defective areas.
  • Assisting engineers in submission of processes and operations that assure proper function of product and test equipment per design specifications by working from general block diagrams, rough outlines of basic circuits, oral instructions, schematics, etc.; making necessary calculations to obtain or compare data as required.
  • Performing initial procedural tests on new and/or changed equipment; submitting recommendations for modifications as required to achieve desired results.
  • Submission of defects reporting, non-conforming materials reports, and communication with production team in resolution of defects/product failures.
  • Any other task assigned by supervisor.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school Diploma or equivalent.
  • Performs complex testing and moderate problem solving on digital systems and subassemblies.
  • Sold understanding of manufacturing quality standards and can read schematics or other technical data as needed.
  • Ability to prepare complex test reports and data in accordance with functional and acceptance level test procedures, may be requested to assist with red-lining of existing functional testing procedures.
  • Performs complex testing; Thermal, Shock, Vibration and Environmental Tests.
  • Troubleshoots and is able to determine root cause for issues with assemblies, debugging of moderate to complex problems.
  • Uses a variety of test equipment; including oscilloscopes, digital multi-meters, serial emulators, networking devices, and other tools found in a testing laboratory to ensure the highest quality of integrated and tested products.
  • Work with others in team environment to meet deadlines and complete tasks in a timely manner. Ideal candidates will have the ability to communicate with other team members and associated parties in a thorough and timely manner.
  • Knowledge of practical applications of engineering and technology, able to apply principles, techniques, and procedures to manufacturing processes, knowledge of design techniques and principals involved in manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing efficiency within manufacturing. Ability to read and perform test procedures and communicate effectively in the event of potential issues.
  • Ability to determine root cause(s) of operating errors and methodologies used to resolve them; ability to apply logic and reason to identify complex problems and develop solutions, ability to predict how changes in operations and process flow will affect manufacturing efficiencies and quality of finished product.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex schematics and functional/diagnostic specifications for determining root cause of failures in test environment.
  • Training: Able to maintain training to applicable equipment and procedures as assigned per job title.
  • Microsoft Office suite skills are a must. A successful candidate should have a broad understanding of computer systems; including a basic understanding of TCP/IP, serial communications, RDP use, Linux and basic command structure, and a rudimentary ability to interpret and modify plain-text scripts as needed. Factory Logix, Oracle, Xilinx Suites, Dediprog, ProComm, SecureCRT, TeraTerm application knowledge is a plus.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Factory Logix, Oracle, Xilinx Suites, Dediprog, ProComm, SecureCRT, TeraTerm application knowledge is a plus.

This position requires you to have or obtain a government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.
