title: Maintenance Tech
description:
Maintenance Technician I & II

Tulsa, OK

Maintenance Tech I Pay $32 - $34 Hourly

Maintenance Tech II Pay $36 - $38 Hourly

1st, 2nd & 3rd Shift

Capstone is a North American supply chain solutions partner with more than 650 operating locations, 19,000 associates, and 60,000 carriers. We have capabilities in freight management, warehouse and distribution center support, last-mile delivery, supply chain analytics, and optimization, and more. Our integrated, end-to-end logistics solutions uniquely position us to help partners reduce warehousing and transportation costs.

JOB SUMMARY:

This role is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting automated warehouse equipment and material handling systems to maximize equipment uptime, safety, and operational efficiency.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Responsibilities:

General Maintenance:

  • Reassemble machines after the completion of repair or maintenance work.
  • Start machines and observe mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems.
  • Inspect or test damaged machine parts and mark defective areas or advise supervisors of repair needs.
  • Lubricate or apply adhesives or other materials to machines, machine parts, or other equipment, according to specified procedures.
  • Install, replace, or change machine parts and attachments, according to production specifications.
  • Dismantle machines and remove parts for repair, using hand tools, chain falls, jacks, cranes, or hoists.
  • Record production, repair, and machine maintenance information.
  • Read work orders and specifications to determine machines and equipment requiring repair or maintenance.
  • Set up and operate machines and adjust controls to regulate operations.
  • Collaborate with other workers to repair or move machines, machine parts, or equipment.
  • Inventory and requisition machine parts, equipment, and other supplies so that stock can be maintained and replenished.
  • Transport machine parts, tools, equipment, and other material between work areas and storage, using cranes, hoists, or dollies.
  • Collect and discard worn machine parts to maintain machinery and work areas.
  • Clean machines and machine parts, using cleaning solvents, cloths, air guns, hoses, vacuums, or other equipment.
  • Coordinate with vendors and manage Purchase Orders for maintenance/repair activities.
  • Perform hands-on maintenance and troubleshooting of automated case-handling, palletizing, and depalletizing systems. Vertique/System Logistics equipment experience strongly preferred.
  • Support and troubleshoot AGV/LGV fleet operations, including E80 Group (Elettric80) laser-guided vehicles, with experience related to navigation systems, battery/charging systems, and safety scanner troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose and resolve automation equipment issues involving PLC-driven controls, servo motors, VFDs/drives, conveyors, and robotic systems.
  • Interpret electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic schematics and utilize fault codes from automation HMI or SCADA interfaces to troubleshoot equipment issues.
  • Partner with OEM field service technicians and coordinate vendor support, Purchase Orders, warranty claims, and equipment repair activities.

MHE:

  • Conduct regular inspections of MHE, such as forklifts, conveyor systems, and pallet jacks.
  • Maintain detailed records of maintenance activities.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues.
  • Repair or replace faulty components.
  • Test repaired equipment to ensure proper functionality.
  • Ensure that all MHE is maintained to safety standards.
  • Troubleshoot equipment failures, provide root cause analysis, research potential warranty and repeat failures for continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate with vendors and manage Purchase Orders for maintenance/repair activities.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on automated warehouse systems within a high-throughput distribution, warehouse, beverage, or CPG environment.
  • Apply basic electrical troubleshooting skills on low- and medium-voltage systems while following established lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.

Required/Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience maintaining and troubleshooting automated material handling systems in a high-throughput distribution, warehouse, beverage, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with PLC-driven controls, servo motors, VFDs/drives, conveyor systems, robotic diagnostics, and automated equipment troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic schematics and troubleshoot equipment through HMI/SCADA interfaces.
  • Experience partnering with OEM field service technicians and managing vendor Purchase Order and warranty workflows.
  • Relevant certifications a plus, including OSHA 10/30, forklift/MHE operation, or manufacturer-specific automation training.
  • Lockout/tagout proficiency and demonstrated commitment to safe maintenance practices.

Performs additional responsibilities as assigned.

title: Funeral Director & Embalmer
description:
PLEASE NOTE: This position is based at Herr Funeral Home & Cremation Services in Collinsville, IL. Candidates must hold an active Illinois Funeral Director and Embalmer License or be eligible to obtain an Illinois license through license reciprocity.


Herr Funeral Home & Cremation Services in Collinsville, IL


Why Everstory

At Everstory Partners, our mission is to create supportive spaces where individuals and families can find solace, meaning, and hope in the midst of loss. At the heart of our mission is a deep understanding of the profound and complex nature of grief. Every person’s journey through loss is unique, and we are committed to providing compassionate and personalized support. We also believe that grief is not a problem to be solved or a burden to manage alone, but rather a natural and beautiful part of the human experience. Backed by our national strength and our local partners’ role is to be a steady presence, a source of comfort and guidance, and a partner in celebrating the life and legacy of the person who has passed.


The Impact You Will Make

The Funeral Director/Embalmer is a significant role that has the opportunity to transform a person's final event into a beautiful celebration of their life through the arrangements and services they offer the deceased and their loved ones. This role will be an empathetic professional that understands the value of providing our families with all options in their time of need. In this position, you will also be responsible for:

  • Meeting with clients to make funeral arrangements, explains service options, assists in casket selection, provides pricing information, and prepares standardized contracts for services.
  • Performing technical and cosmological embalming services.
  • Finalizing details discussed during arrangement conferences with with appropriate tracking & compliance documents.
  • Directing funeral services and visitation, including greeting family members, opening parlor, coordinating and instructing pallbearers, greeting and escorting clergy to chapel. May assist with funerals while not acting as primary director or act as hearse or limousine driver when needed.
  • Preparing or coordinates preparation and issuance of permits and documents associated with funerals and embalming. This includes death certificate, permits from coroner, writing embalming case study and others as required.
  • Removing and transports deceased from home or hospital to funeral home.
  • Maintaining cleanliness of preparation room and equipment.
  • Performing all other related functions as assigned.


Core Competencies:

  • Compassion - Genuinely cares about people; is concerned about their work and non-work problems; is available and ready to help; is sympathetic to the plight of others not as fortunate; demonstrates real empathy with the joys and pains of others.
  • Customer Focus - Is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; gets first-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services; acts with customers in mind; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.
  • Ethics and Values - Adheres to appropriate (for the setting) and effective set of core values and beliefs during both good and bad times; acts in line with those values; rewards the right values and disapproves of others; practices what he/she preaches.

Client & Account Management

title: Senior Component Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

Mercury Systems IPS business unit has a great opportunity for an electrical engineer who specializes in Component Engineering to make an impact, and the ability help mature our component process and framework right away. We are seeking an experienced Components Engineer, Parts Engineer or Reliability Engineer to support our classified warfare products and related technologies. If selected, you will be part of the Parts, Materials, and Processes (PMP) Team supporting a large production program in the Integrated Processing Solutions business unit. Our products include aerospace systems that protect warfighters, noncombatants, and critical infrastructure. The work we do is making a difference in the world – today. This is a very hands-on, collaborative company and we value your input.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a EEEE parts or materials and processes expert in a robust PMP program supporting a multimillion-dollar franchise production program.
  • Lead component reviews, analysis, and assessment against program compliance requirements for space and military programs.
  • Collaborate closely with the customer, other government agencies, and cross-functional teams to resolve supply chain issues, review, improve, and document PMP activities, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Provide technical assessments to Material Review Boards (MRBs) to resolve non-conformances.
  • Researching and determining the impact of PCNs and obsolescence on programs
  • Leading component part standardization, part selection, and process change notices
  • Developing EEE parts specifications detailing component screening and t qualification test plans and executing part qualifications with test houses
  • Create and submit NSPARs for customer review and approval supporting component screening and qualification plans. Presenting non-standard parts and materials to customers, defending the use of non-standard parts and materials. Skillfully present detailed technical information to internal and external customers with confidence.
  • Participate in RCCA and CAR/SCAR activities as needed.
  • Support periodic audits of suppliers’ facilities and processes.
  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Mentor more junior engineers and actively contribute to knowledge-sharing culture.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate reports, databases and PMPCB meeting agendas and minutes.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, materials engineering, materials science or related discipline.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in related industry (i.e. defense, electronics) or two years plus a master’s degree in related disciplines.
  • Knowledge of common military and industry specifications and standards (MIL, ASTM, AEC, ESA, NASA, etc.)
  • Experience collaborating with and managing suppliers, and requesting PPAPs, qualification reports, additional documentation.
  • Knowledge of electronic fabrication techniques and processes such as SMT, chip and wire, hybrids, etc.
  • Experience with the design and manufacture of electronic circuit card assemblies.
  • Experience with the NSMAR NSPAR process or/and forms.
  • Familiar with environmental testing per MIL-STD-883 (this is required); MIL-PRF-38534, 38535, passive components, etc.
  • Clear communication – both oral and written – and a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work remotely as part of larger team.
  • The ability to obtain a US DoD Secret Clerance. US Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Understanding of component ratings, and Derating requirement
  • Understanding of failure modes in capacitors and packaged active devices.
  • Prior experience in Design Engineering role, especially on space-based programs.
  • Experience designing complex embedded digital hardware products from concept to completion
  • Experience designing complex circuits with microprocessors, FPGAs, or network switches
  • Prior experience in Quality or Supplier Quality organizations; familiarity with SAE AS9100 and AS9102. Knowledge of QMS requirements.
  • Proficiency in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), MES (Manufacturing Execution System), Quality Management System (QMS), and MS Office software.
  • An Active DoD Secret Clerance or higher.

Work Location:

  • This position is hybrid and candidate must be in a commutable location to one of our facilities in:
    • Cypress, CA
    • Huntsville, AL
    • Andover, MA
    • Chantilly, VA
  • Enjoy every other Friday off with our 9/80 work schedule!

title: Data Steward
description:
Help Shape How Global Teams Discover, Govern and Leverage External Data


Are you passionate about data governance, metadata management and creating transparency across complex data ecosystems?


We're looking for a Data Steward to play a key role in managing and governing externally sourced data assets used by teams across a global organisation. This is an opportunity to sit at the centre of business, analytics, governance and vendor relationships, helping ensure that high-value external data is documented, accessible and delivering maximum value to the organisation.


If you enjoy bringing structure to complex information, collaborating with stakeholders across multiple functions and driving improvements in data quality and governance, this could be an ideal next step.


What You'll Be Doing


As a trusted steward of third-party data assets, you'll:


  • Support teams globally with the documentation, onboarding and lifecycle management of external data assets
  • Create and maintain high-quality metadata and business documentation within enterprise data catalogues
  • Partner with analytics, data operations and governance teams to improve transparency and discoverability of external datasets
  • Coordinate with vendors to resolve data quality issues, manage updates and support continuous improvement initiatives
  • Help identify opportunities to maximise the value and re-use of third-party data across the organisation
  • Support research into new external data sources and emerging datasets
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, procurement, governance and external suppliers to ensure effective data management practices


What We're Looking For


We're keen to speak with professionals who bring:


  • Experience within Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Data Management or Metadata Management
  • Experience working with data catalogues, metadata frameworks and data asset documentation
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams
  • Experience coordinating with external vendors, suppliers or third-party data providers
  • Confidence reviewing contracts, data documentation and business requirements
  • Excellent communication skills in English


Bonus Points For


  • Experience working within Life Sciences, Healthcare or other regulated industries
  • Hands-on experience with Collibra
  • Exposure to Snowflake
  • Experience with contract repository or workflow management tools
  • Knowledge of external data acquisition or vendor data management processes


Location


Barcelona (Sant Cugat) | Hybrid working with one day per week onsite.

title: Product Manager III
description:
Job Summary:

In this role, you have the opportunity to join a growing team as a Product Manager within Mercury Systems’ Signal Technologies Mixed Signal Line of Business. You will collaborate with product leadership, engineering, operations, product marketing, and Line of Business leads to define and execute product strategies that meet the needs of defense and aerospace customers. This role bridges the gap between customer requirements and what can be built—serving as an advocate internally with engineering and operations teams and externally with suppliers, partners, and end users.

You will help evolve an established and expanding product line, applying your technical and business expertise to deliver differentiated mixed-signal solutions for mission-critical applications. You will be responsible for lifecycle execution, roadmap development, documentation leadership, and overall product line performance.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Driving operational aspects of new product introduction from concept through development, production, and end‑of‑life.
  • Developing and maintaining product roadmaps aligned with customer capability needs in defense, aerospace, and signal‑intelligence markets.
  • Coordinating product roadmaps with the Advanced Concept Group and associated technology roadmaps.
  • Monitoring industry, technology, and competitive trends to ensure product line competitiveness and long‑term differentiation.
  • Collaborating closely with engineering, operations, sales, product marketing, and Line of Business leads to achieve product lifecycle, cost, schedule, and performance goals.
  • Supporting Sales with identifying and capturing strategic customer design wins and providing technical insights to help articulate customer value.
  • Managing product operations, promoting enhancement of standard services and associated revenue opportunities across the Mixed Signal portfolio.
  • Owning all product documentation including manuals, data sheets, user guides, application notes, and release documentation. Technical documentation will be a significant responsibility.
  • Creating, updating, and maintaining accurate, customer‑ready documentation that enhances customer experience and reduces support burden.
  • Engaging with customers, field engineers, and support teams to gather feedback ensuring documentation meets user needs.
  • Establishing documentation standards and quality processes across the product line.
  • Building relationships with customer technical leaders to gain insight into future opportunities, mission requirements, and technology trends.
  • Leading competitive product analysis based on customer interactions and application requirements.
  • Driving creation of sales and marketing collateral aligned with product positioning and roadmap.
  • Developing and execute product launch and marketing strategies.
  • Collaborating with Line of Business leads on financial forecasting including bookings, revenue, and profitability.
  • Developing strategies to increase product line profitability.
  • Owning end‑of‑life planning, long‑term supply strategies, and lifecycle management for all assigned mixed‑signal products.
  • Coordinating End-of-Life mitigation strategies (including lifetime buys, re-spins, and redesigns) with Supply Chain Management and Engineering.
  • Track projects, documentation metrics, and product KPIs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 4 years of product management or operations experience in aerospace, defense, semiconductor, or technical/industrial environments.
  • Strong understanding of hardware and software development processes.
  • Experience authoring customer facing technical documentation.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
  • Experience working cross‑functionally and engaging directly with customers.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%
  • This position requires you to have or be able to obtain a government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.

title: Gen AI Web Engineer: Build Scalable AI Apps
description:
What The Role Is

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is seeking a skilled Software Engineer to join our Gen AI team and develop next-generation applications powered by advanced AI technologies. This role focuses on hands-on implementation of AI-driven applications using cutting-edge AI frameworks that support MAS’ role in the Singapore's financial sector, whilst ensuring robust governance and operational excellence.

What The Role Is

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is seeking a skilled Software Engineer to join our Gen AI team and develop next-generation applications powered by advanced AI technologies. This role focuses on hands-on implementation of AI-driven applications using cutting-edge AI frameworks that support MAS’ role in the Singapore's financial sector, whilst ensuring robust governance and operational excellence.

As a Software Engineer, you will implement and build production-grade web applications that leverage large language models and agentic AI systems. You will work with modern AI frameworks to develop user-facing applications that enhance productivity for AI developers, data scientists, and end users across MAS.

What You Will Be Working On

Agentic Web Application Development

Implement robust, scalable applications that enable autonomous AI agents using AI Frameworks (e.g. LangGraph ) for complex multi-step reasoning and decision-making workflows. Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces that allow users to interact with, monitor, and control AI agents performing complex tasks and workflows.

Search & Retrieval Development

Implement web services and APIs that enable efficient search and retrieval of information from large-scale data repositories ( e.g. Elastic / Redis) using hybrid search capabilities. Build data ingestion pipelines and vector indexing workflows that support real-time query processing and document retrieval. Develop robust error handling and fallback mechanisms for search service integration, including query reformulation and result ranking optimisation.

User Interface & Experience Implementation

Build intuitive web interfaces that enable MAS officers to interact with complex AI systems with lower learning curve . Implement dashboards, configuration panels, and monitoring interfaces that provide clear visibility into AI application performance and behaviour.

Performance Optimisation & Scalability

Implement performance optimisations for web applications handling AI workloads. Build caching mechanisms, request queuing systems, and load balancing solutions that ensure responsive user experiences even under heavy AI processing loads.

Security & Compliance Implementation

Implement security measures including authentication, authorisation, and data protection within web applications. Ensure all developments adhere to MAS operational controls and regulatory standards through proper implementation of security features and audit logging.

What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum 3-5 years experience as a full stack developer, with p roven track record in the production of enterprise-grade applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security.
  • Strong proficiency in Python web frameworks ( FastAPI , Django) and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js, or Angular) and responsive web design
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful API development and integration
  • Knowledge of database integration (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and ORM frameworks

AI Framework Implementation

  • Practical experience with AI Frameworks (e.g. LangGraph ) for building AI agent workflows and state management
  • Hands-on experience with self-hosted inference services vLLM for LLM interactions and parsing
  • Practical knowledge of LLM API integration and prompt engineering

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

This is a 1-year contract position. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About Endowus

Endowus is an award-winning, independent fee-only wealth platform licensed in Singapore (MAS 101051) and Hong Kong (SFC BQR225). We serve over 300,000 clients—individuals, family offices, charities, and institutions—with over US$12 billion in assets under advice.

About Endowus

Endowus is an award-winning, independent fee-only wealth platform licensed in Singapore (MAS 101051) and Hong Kong (SFC BQR225). We serve over 300,000 clients—individuals, family offices, charities, and institutions—with over US$12 billion in assets under advice. Our mission: help people invest better so they can live easier today, and better tomorrow. Today, we work with 100+ global leading asset managers across major asset classes – public markets, private markets, hedge funds and alternatives – and make it our job to assess and access their Best-in-Class funds, and advise clients on how to invest in these funds to reach their goals. The team has deep domain knowledge in finance and technology, bringing together decades of experience from various banks and tech companies. We treasure our diversity in background and experience, and we look for people who share these beliefs in our mission.

The Opportunity

We are hiring our first Analytics Engineer to build the data models and metric definitions that power analytics across Endowus. Reporting to our Data Analytics Manager, you will develop and own our data models on dbt, the automated tests that keep them reliable, and the metric definitions feeding our semantic layer and BI tools. You will design models that enable core teams including Product, Marketing, and Operations to get to answers faster. This role offers a rare opportunity to structure complex financial domains - from client portfolios and fund transactions to multi-currency valuations across two markets. As we rapidly adopt AI tools, you will gain hands‑on experience building the governed data foundations that make self‑serve analytics and AI‑assisted workflows reliable.

What You’ll Do

  • Model the data. Build and maintain dbt models end-to-end, collaborating with Data Engineering and software engineers to transform source data into clean, intuitive models for business teams.
  • Make it trustworthy. Implement automated testing, freshness monitoring, and dbt documentation so model changes are traceable, tested, and reliable.
  • Govern the metrics. Partner with business stakeholders and analysts to standardise core metric definitions, establishing a canonical source of truth for key business numbers.
  • Enable self-serve. Support our transition to a dbt-native BI layer, designing data models and semantic definitions that make independent querying intuitive for cross‑functional teams.

Where This Role Grows

You will play a central role in shaping analytics engineering as a practice at Endowus. As our platform matures, this seat offers clear opportunities for long‑term growth: taking full ownership of our semantic layer and analytics architecture, bridging into data engineering, or driving technical direction as the team expands. We work with you directly to tailor your growth path as your scope expands.

The Must-Haves

  • SQL depth. You have 1 to 3 years of hands‑on SQL experience, using CTEs, window functions and nested structures to build performant, reusable logic.
  • Engineering mindset. You take a structured approach to analytics, using version control, code reviews, and testing to build maintainable models.
  • Systems thinking. You view source data, transformations, semantic layers, and BI as one connected system, anticipating downstream impacts before modifying a model or definition.
  • Clear technical writing. You write clear specs, documentation, and metric definitions, exercising good judgment to refine AI outputs into concise, human‑centered text.
  • AI‑native curiosity. You actively use AI tools to accelerate your work, driven by a genuine curiosity about our data and business.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You thrive on loosely defined problems, taking the initiative to gather context, state your assumptions, and move forward.

The Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Hands‑on experience with dbt, Git, or version‑controlled data transformation workflows.
  • Experience querying cloud data platforms or engines (AWS Athena, BigQuery, Snowflake).
  • Familiarity with modern BI platforms (Mode, Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and an interest in semantic layer concepts.
  • Exposure to event tracking or product analytics tools (Amplitude, GA4, or equivalent).
  • Exposure to or strong interest in financial services, wealth management, or investment concepts.

Why Not Endowus

  • You demand perfect architecture over iterative progress. We value robust data design, but we operate in a fast‑paced business. Success means developing the pragmatism to know when a scalable, long‑term model is required, and when an iterative solution is the right call.
  • You want a fully mapped‑out, mature stack to maintain. Analytics engineering is a growing discipline here. You get the opportunity to define conventions and build patterns from the ground up alongside a supportive data team.
  • You expect fully standardised data and rigid specs. Source data here may not always be neatly structured upfront. You will collaborate with stakeholders to gather context and define requirements, with the autonomy to innovate on how data is modelled.

How We Hire

  • Hiring Manager Conversation (45 min) — Discussion on your technical background, approach to data modelling, and stakeholder management.
  • Take‑Home Case Study (2 hours, plus review) — A practical modelling scenario using synthetic data where you frame the problem, account for edge cases, and walk through assumptions with a peer panel.
  • Final Conversation — Chat with our Product & Data Director focused on team fit and alignment.

Our Investors, recognition, licensing

Founded in 2017, Endowus has raised over US$130 million from investors including UBS, EDBI, Prosus Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners, Singtel Innov8, Samsung Ventures, SBVA, Illuminate Financial, OSK Ventures, Z Venture Capital, and ACF – a joint venture between JLIN LLC and The Wells Investments. Endowus also counts some of the largest billionaire family offices in Asia among its investors. Endowus partners with 1,000+ global fund managers across public markets, private markets, hedge funds, and alternatives to deliver world‑class solutions at transparent cost through its fee‑only model. Private Wealth clients access curated strategies from firms such as EQT, Carlyle, Partners Group, KKR, Ares, Brookfield Oaktree, HarbourVest, Millennium, Point72, Bridgewater, and more. Recognition includes CNBC's World's Top FinTech Companies 2025, the Financial Times' High-Growth Companies Asia Pacific 2025 (#45), Fortune Fintech Innovators Asia 2024, and the World Economic Forum's Technology Pioneers 2023. The platform has won Asia's Best Digital Wealth Management and Hong Kong's Best FinTech Innovation in Asset Management (Asia Asset Management 2025), Singapore's Best Digital Wealth Management Experience (The Asset Triple A 2025), and Best WealthTech Solution 2023 (Asian Private Banker). The Endowus Group comprises licensed companies in Hong Kong and Singapore, and Hong Kong‑based multi‑family office Carret Private. With group assets over US$12 billion, Endowus is one of the largest independent wealth managers in Asia, estimated to save clients more than US$50 million in fees per year.

Digital & High-Speed Technologies

title: FSO/ISSM
description:
Job Summary:
In this role, you will serve as the Facility Security Officer (FSO) for the Oxnard, CA site, with full responsibility for ensuring compliance with the National Industrial Security Program (NISP). In this dual-function position, you will also act as the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), overseeing the security of classified information systems across multiple Mercury locations.

As the FSO, you will manage all aspects of NISP compliance, implement and enforce security policies and procedures, and ensure full adherence to U.S. Government requirements. As the ISSM, you will be responsible for the overall security posture of classified information systems, including configuration, protection, assessment, and accreditation under the DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF).

Key responsibilities include aligning security program goals with organizational objectives, assessing and mitigating risk, ensuring regulatory compliance, protecting personnel, information, facilities, and business operations.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the Corporate ISSM to ensure all accredited information systems meet RMF requirements.
  • Prepare, maintain, and upload System Security Plans (SSPs) and supporting artifacts in eMASS.
  • Ensure SSPs accurately reflect system configuration and required security controls.
  • Support certification testing and assessments conducted by the Cognizant Security Agency (CSA).
  • Maintain facility information system records in eMASS.
  • Develop and maintain procedures supporting Configuration Management (CM) for security relevant hardware, software, and firmware.
  • Conduct risk and vulnerability assessments of classified systems and verify the effectiveness of security controls.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD certification and accreditation requirements, including DoDI 8510.01 (RMF for DoD IT).
  • Install, update, and maintain security-related software tools to detect malicious code, viruses, and unauthorized intrusions.
  • Provide Security guidance to and regularly interact with Program Managers, Engineering/Production, Management, and Human Resources.
  • Responsible for the administration and coordination of the DOD and other industrial security programs and activities to ensure compliance with 32 CFR 117 and other government and company security policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate due diligence and risk assessments whose objective is to identify improvements in the existing physical security controls in place for non-NISP security function at assigned facilities.
  • Maintain and provide security classification guidance of DD254’s, Security Classification Guides, and other documents related to security requirements for assigned programs.
  • Operate and maintain a security education, training, and awareness program to include indoctrinations, annual refresher training, debriefings, courier, travel, event specific briefings, and OPSEC procedures.
  • Respond to intrusion alarms as needed.
  • Manage physical security for the site, including intrusion detection, access control, CCTV, security hardware, and GSA approved containers.
  • Respond to intrusion alarms as necessary.
  • Be the direct liaison for the facility with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DSCA) and other government agencies.

Required Qualifications:

  • Typically requires 4 years of experience in cybersecurity, information systems security, RMF, and Certification & Accreditation (C&A) processes.
  • Active Secret Clearance.
  • Experience working with eMASS and RMF procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct thorough risk assessments and manage complex documentation.
  • Experience of network assets and peripheral equipment.
  • Maintain facility and personnel information in DISS and NISS.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with large, multi‑facility networks in Windows and Linux environments.
  • Familiarity with cyber incident response, including preservation, containment, and eradication.
  • CISSP, CASP, or similar certification.
  • FSO & ISSM Certification with in 6 months of hire.
  • Master's degree in Information Systems or related field.
  • High initiative, strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and organizational capability.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.

  • Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments and ensure compliance with recognised frameworks including NIST SP 800-82, IEC 62443, FISMA, and organisational security policies.

Requirements

  • Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT security, or OT security roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), IDS/IPS, endpoint detection, and security monitoring technologies.
  • Experience performing vulnerability management, security assessments, and incident response.
  • Strong understanding of Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), or SCADA security concepts.
  • Good knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks including NIST, IEC 62443, FISMA, or equivalent standards.

title: Test Technician III
description:
The Senior Test Technician (ESS) is responsible for performing environmental stress screening and testing to validate product performance under various conditions, ensuring compliance with MIL-STD-810 and customer specifications. This role involves operating environmental test equipment, maintaining detailed documentation, and supporting engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality products.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Operate and maintain environmental test equipment, including thermal chambers, vibration tables, and centrifuges, ensuring proper calibration and reliability.
  • Conduct environmental tests such as temperature cycling, thermal shock, burn-in, random/sine vibration (powered and unpowered), and constant acceleration according to MIL-STD-810 and customer specifications.
  • Set up test fixtures and instrumentation per test procedures, monitor test progress, and intervene when anomalies are detected to ensure test integrity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve equipment or test setup issues, identifying and recommending equipment upgrades or replacements as needed.
  • Record, analyze, and report test results with accuracy and completeness, maintaining detailed test logs and chain of custody documentation.
  • Generate comprehensive test reports and present findings to engineering teams to support product validation and design improvements.
  • Coordinate preventative maintenance and service calls, documenting equipment maintenance history and calibration records.
  • Work from schematics, work instructions, drawings, and operating procedures while ensuring adherence to safety protocols and compliance with relevant standards.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to refine test procedures and participate in continuous improvement initiatives for test processes.
  • Cross-train and mentor new employees and junior technicians, while communicating goals and priorities with management to maintain project deadlines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in electronics, engineering technology, or a related field; relevant technical certifications may substitute for degree with equivalent experience.
  • Typically 2-5 years in environmental or laboratory testing with demonstrated knowledge of MIL-STD-810 and experience with data acquisition systems and test instrumentation.
  • Proficiency in operating environmental test systems (thermal chambers, shakers, etc.), understanding of basic electronics, and ability to read technical drawings/schematics.
  • Strong analytical abilities with attention to detail and competency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for data analysis and reporting.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with team-oriented approach and ability to collaborate across departments.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's in electronics, engineering technology, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in aerospace or defense industries.
  • Experience with environmental chamber programming and automation.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds regularly.

description:
TARGET CLOSE DATE:

09/25/2026

PAY GRADE:

Grade 14

TYPE:

Full time

JOB SUMMARY:

The City of Bessemer is seeking to hire an Animal Control Officer to investigate complaints and resolve issues while patrolling an assigned area of the city using a city vehicle. Animal Control Officers may handle a variety of complaints and requests, including capture and relocation of wildlife, capture of stray or dangerous animals, removal and disposal of dead animals in and around roadways or other public areas, and investigation of animal abuse or neglect complaints. Animal Control Officers also issue warnings, citations, and court summons to violators of animal control regulations. Employees in this job class must exercise considerable concern for safety when dealing with angry citizens and dangerous animals. Animal Control Officers are responsible for keeping detailed records of their daily operations.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The City of Bessemer provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefit packages to include medical and dental insurance, employer-sponsored retirement plan (pension), generous paid holidays, sick and vacation leave, and more.

The pay range for this job is presented below:

$15.85 - $24.59

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

The following are job-related qualifications that are required for employment consideration for this position:

  • Driver's license.

  • Experience in customer service.

TYPICAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Conducts animal control by patrolling assigned area, capturing at-large animals, transporting animals to appropriate location, and completing documentation to ensure safe handling, transportation, and impounding of stray, sick, injured, or abandoned animals.

  • Responds to citizen complaints and conducts enforcement activities pertaining to animal control ordinances and regulations.

  • Communicates with and educates the public to resolve or prevent animal control issues.

  • Conducts administrative duties such as purchase orders, contract bids, bills, and veterinary services.

  • Completes daily activity log to include areas/addresses visited, associated timeframes, and relevant notes about animals or owners.

  • Completes proper disposal measures for animals that are deceased (e.g., hit by vehicles).

  • Encourages and promotes the importance of animal control preventative measures (e.g., spay/neutering, fencing) when communicating with pet owners and complainants.

  • Collects owner surrendered animals by verifying ownership, collecting fee, completing documentation, and transporting animal.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Job involves moderate physical exertion for sustained periods of physical activity such as walking or standing. May involve occasional lifting of items or objects weighing up to 50 lbs. Work involves physical ability necessary to occasionally restrain or capture stray or dangerous animals and wildlife.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed both within employer-owned facilities such as workshop, warehouse, or station and in field locations such as external places of business and residences. title: Channel Partnerships Lead — Referrals & Affiliates
description:
About HitPay

HitPay is the all-in-one payments and financial operations platform for SMEs — payments, payouts, invoicing, POS, and more in one place. We've served 15,000+ SMEs, saved merchants US$35M+ in fees, hold a Trustpilot 4.4/5, and were named among the world's and Singapore's leading fintech companies (CNBC / Tech in Asia × Statista, 2026). We're a fast-moving, AI-native team that ships fast and carries almost no bureaucracy.

The role

You'll own HitPay's channel partnerships motion — growth through other people's networks, not one merchant at a time.

This is a partnerships lead role focused on channel: referral partners, affiliates, resellers, and ecosystem distributors who consistently send qualified SMEs into HitPay. You build the partner program, recruit and activate partners, design incentives that work, and turn partner-sourced pipeline into predictable revenue.

Primary channels you'll own

  1. Referral & affiliate partners — agencies, web/e-commerce dev shops, consultants, accountants/bookkeepers, Shopify/WooCommerce partners, and other advisors who refer merchants into HitPay.
  2. Reseller / channel distributors — POS resellers and partners who resell HitPay and earn margin.
  3. Program ops — enablement, attribution, incentives, partner payouts, and the playbooks that make the channel compound.

(Embedded platform / HitPay Connect deals sit adjacent — you may collaborate, but this seat is not the Connect closer. Channel + referrals is the job.)

What you'll do

Build and scale the channel

  • Define the channel strategy: which partner types, which markets (SG / MY / PH / HK / AU / US), and what "good" looks like for partner-sourced TPV, revenue, and activation.
  • Recruit, onboard, and activate high-fit partners; keep a living pipeline of prospects and a clear tiering model (self-serve → high-touch).
  • Design and iterate incentives (referral fees, recurring share, reseller margin) so partners stay motivated and unit economics stay healthy.

Run the program end-to-end

  • Own HitPay's Refer & Earn / affiliate program: enablement kits, tracking & attribution, partner portals/comms, and timely partner payouts.
  • Stand up reseller motions where partners want to sell HitPay (pricing guidance, deal desk hygiene, handoff to Sales).
  • Enable partners so they can pitch HitPay without you in every room — demos, one-pagers, objection handling, co-sell playbooks.

Drive pipeline and revenue

  • Own partner-sourced leads, pipeline, win rate, and revenue forecasts; make the channel a visible, trusted contribution to GTM.
  • Work tightly with Sales so referred leads are qualified, worked, and attributed correctly — no black holes.
  • Partner with Marketing on co-marketing, partner webinars, and campaigns that feed the channel.

Operate with discipline

  • Keep HubSpot (or our CRM) tight: partner records, sourced opportunities, stages, and reporting leadership can trust.
  • Negotiate and close partner agreements with Legal/Finance; keep commercial terms clean and compliant.
  • Feed partner and market signal back to Product and GTM so we ship what channels actually need.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in channel partnerships, partner/channel sales, affiliate/referral programs, or BD — ideally payments, fintech, or B2B SaaS.
  • Proven track record building or scaling a partner/referral channel that produced measurable pipeline and revenue (not just managing a static list).
  • Strong commercial judgment: incentive design, revenue share, CPA vs recurring economics, and when to say no to a bad partner.
  • Comfortable recruiting partners outbound and running a many-partner program without drowning in ops.
  • Disciplined CRM and forecasting habits; you report numbers you can defend.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; can work across APAC markets and time zones.
  • Self-directed and fast — thrives with autonomy and minimal process.

Bonus points

  • Existing network of agencies, e-commerce partners, accountants, or POS/reseller channels in APAC.
  • Experience running referral/affiliate tooling (PartnerStack, Impact, FirstPromoter, Rewardful, or in-house equivalents).
  • Prior payments/fintech channel experience (acquirer, payfac, POS, or SaaS billing).
  • You've launched a partner program from near-zero and made it a real GTM line.

  • Assisting engineers in submission of processes and operations that assure proper function of product and test equipment per design specifications by working from general block diagrams, rough outlines of basic circuits, oral instructions, schematics, etc.; making necessary calculations to obtain or compare data as required.
  • Performing initial procedural tests on new and/or changed equipment; submitting recommendations for modifications as required to achieve desired results.

Has a solid understanding of manufacturing quality standards and can read schematics or other technical data as needed. Preferred Qualification:

description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure/platform team. You will design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, with a strong focus on AWS and Red Hat OpenShift environments. This role has a strong DevSecOps component - you will be expected to embed security practices throughout the development and deployment lifecycle, not treat it as an afterthought.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Platform

  • Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) for AWS cloud environments
  • Deploy, manage, and optimize containerized applications on Red Hat OpenShift (OKD/OCP)
  • Manage Kubernetes/OpenShift clusters, including scaling, upgrades, and patching
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues

CI/CD & Automation

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support development and release cycles
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks to improve deployment speed and reliability
  • Implement pipeline security gates (e.g., automated approval blocks on failed scans)

DevSecOps / Security Integration

  • Embed security checks across the SDLC ("shift left") - including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic testing (DAST), and software composition analysis (SCA)
  • Perform container/image vulnerability scanning before deployment to OpenShift (e.g., Trivy, Clair, Red Hat ACS/StackRox)
  • Manage secrets securely using tools like HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or OpenShift Secrets
  • Implement policy-as-code and compliance-as-code (e.g., Open Policy Agent, OPA Gatekeeper) to enforce security and governance guardrails
  • Apply IAM least-privilege principles across AWS and OpenShift RBAC configurations
  • Monitor for security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance drift in infrastructure and pipelines
  • Support security audits, vulnerability remediation, and incident response processes
  • Collaborate with security teams to align with organizational compliance frameworks

Monitoring & Reliability

  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
  • Support disaster recovery, backup strategies, and incident response procedures
  • Document infrastructure architecture, security controls, runbooks, and operational procedures

Requirements

  • Singapore Citizen , based in Singapore
  • 3-5 years of relevant DevOps/DevSecOps/Platform Engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, Lambda, RDS, CloudFormation/Terraform, etc.)
  • Practical experience with Red Hat OpenShift (deployment, cluster management, operators, RBAC)
  • Solid understanding of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Support application deployments, releases and upgrades and investigate deployment failures.
  • Analyse application and system logs, monitoring alerts and performance metrics to identify root causes.
  • Work with Microsoft Azure environments, with exposure to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) highly advantageous.
  • Perform SQL/database investigation where required to diagnose application or data‑related issues.
  • Work closely with Development, DevOps, Infrastructure and external vendors while retaining ownership of the initial technical investigation.
  • Participate in incident management, RCA and continuous improvement of application stability and support processes.
  • Support production environments that may require after-hours or 24/7 operational coverage.

What we're looking for

  • Hands‑on experience supporting production applications in Kubernetes environments.
  • Practical troubleshooting experience with pods, deployments, services and container/application logs.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure; hands‑on AKS experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of Linux, application troubleshooting and production support.
  • Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Elasticsearch, Datadog or similar.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Exposure to CI/CD, application deployments and release processes.
  • Able to troubleshoot beyond the application itself and investigate potential network, infrastructure, database and configuration issues.
  • Comfortable owning technical investigations before escalating to the appropriate engineering team.

The kind of engineer we're looking for

We're less concerned about whether your current title says Application Support, DevOps, Production Support, Cloud Engineer or Systems Engineer.

What matters is what you actually do when production breaks.

If you're comfortable opening the logs, checking the pods, looking at the deployment, testing connectivity, checking the database and narrowing down the problem before saying “this belongs to another team” — we'd like to speak with you.

title: Hospital Administrator

This role is an opportunity to expand your impact beyond a single hospital, step into multi-site leadership, and partner with hospital teams to strengthen operations, develop leaders, and create a consistent and exceptional experience for our Team Members and clients.

If you’re ready to spread your wings, grow as a leader, and help shape how Cara shows up in every neighborhood we serve, we’d love to meet you.


About the Role

A Hospital Administrator is the operational leader of two or more Cara hospitals, reporting to the Senior Director of Operations. You lead through your Floor Managers and partner with your Medical Director as your medical counterpart, working together to deliver the personalized, quality client experience Cara is known for.

Culture is felt before it is named, and that starts with leadership. As a Hospital Administrator, you set the tone for your hospitals while ensuring every location upholds the Cara standards of Compassion, Consistency, and Quality.


High-level responsibilities include:

  • Owning operational outcomes across your assigned hospitals
  • Coaching and developing Floor Managers as your operational extension on the floor

Our Offer

  • Salary range of $100,000 to $125,000 based on experience
  • Quarterly and annual incentive program tied to performance of your assigned locations
  • Medical, dental, and vision with four premium plan options, including family coverage
  • 401(k) with a 4% employer match
  • 120 hours of PTO, a 10-hour Personal Celebration Day, and 6 paid floating holidays
  • Continuing education reimbursement up to $1,000 annually
  • License renewal reimbursement where applicable
  • Employee pet care discount for up to four personal pets
  • Uniform allowance
  • Employee Assistance Program


Who Will Succeed in This Role

Stepping out of single-unit operations and into multi-unit leadership comes with a learning curve, and at times that curve will be steep. The Cara Support Center is here to support you through this exciting transition. The person who will thrive in this role is a knowledgeable operational leader who is ready to expand their wings and is comfortable not having all the answers, asking questions, and doing the research to find them.

The Hospital Administrator who will succeed at Cara:

Experience in veterinary operations, multi-unit leadership, or a CVPM credential is preferred but not required. What is required is strong leadership experience and the readiness and willingness to grow into a multi-site leadership role.


Ready to Take the Next Step?

Please apply with a fully updated resume.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | SRE (Remote, EU/CET)
description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build secure, reliable, and scalable systems as Maze grows.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack, but you should be excited to learn, move quickly, and make an impact.

As an SRE at Maze, you will:

  • Build, operate, and evolve our cloud infrastructure with reliability, scalability, and security in mind

  • Improve our observability practices and help engineers understand, debug, and operate systems in production

  • Partner across engineering and security to strengthen our cloud security posture and operational practices

  • Support security and compliance initiatives, including vulnerability management, security testing, and audit readiness

  • Build tooling and automation that reduces manual work and improves the developer experience

  • Bring an operational and security perspective to architecture and technical decisions

  • Improve how we prepare for, respond to, and learn from production incidents

  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic workflows to build, debug, and operate systems more effectively

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has experience building and operating production systems in a modern cloud environment, ideally AWS

  • Understands modern SRE and infrastructure practices, including infrastructure as code and containerized workloads

  • Has experience with observability and knows what good monitoring, alerting, and production visibility look like

  • Brings a security mindset, with experience or interest in cloud security, vulnerability management, application security, or related areas

  • Has exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, or is interested in developing deeper expertise in this area

  • Can automate repetitive work using code and is comfortable working with at least one programming language

  • Is excited about AI-assisted development and actively uses modern AI tools in their work

  • Thrives in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and pragmatic decision-making matter

The stack

  • Cloud & infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & compliance: Vanta, Socket

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Argo CD

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Snowflake

  • Application: TypeScript, Node.js, React

You don’t need experience with every technology in our stack. We care more about strong fundamentals, an ability to learn quickly, and excitement about helping us build reliable and secure systems as Maze scales.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex regional matters, identify material risk, present practical options, and make clear, defensible recommendations in ambiguous situations.
  • Experience building or operationalizing privacy and AI compliance programs through policies, assessments, controls, training, governance processes, monitoring, and audit-ready documentation.

  • Excellent drafting and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly and influence technical, commercial, and business stakeholders across jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships, manage multiple priorities, and work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling global environment.

Preferred:

title: Test Engineer III
description:
Job Summary:

Mercury Systems is seeking a Test Engineer III to lead test efforts in our data processing and avionics systems for mission critical aerospace and defense applications. This role plays a pivotal part in ensuring product reliability, performance, and security across the full engineering lifecycle from concept to sustainment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring test systems comply with quality requirements, reliability, and regulatory compliance
  • Work with cross-functional development teams to ensure that products are designed to facilitate testability including qualification, verification and validation requirements
  • Develop, specify and/or procure test equipment that meets quality objectives, design margins and the needs of manufacturing
  • Develop and write test documentation such as compliance matrices; Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP), Qualification Test Procedures (QTP), and Functional Test Procedures (FTP) using test standards such as MIL-STD-810G & H, MIL-STD-704A, and MIL-STD-461F & G
  • Oversee and conduct functional, environmental, stress, and security testing of hardware and software systems, ensuring performance in extreme conditions and mission-critical environments.
  • Work independently under minimal supervision and guidance to perform tasks of substantial complexity and conduct testing activities on site and at testing contract facilities
  • Produce test reports, presentation, and CDRL’s for contractual deliverables
  • Train/cross-train test and troubleshooting techniques with Production test team
  • Troubleshoot systems and circuit card assemblies using relevant electrical, mechanical, and analytical tools to identify root cause and resolve technical issues.
  • Lead the troubleshooting activities, Investigate the cause of the failures and fix the defect at top level assembly, sub-level assembly, PCBA board level, components, and or test equipment
  • Collaborate with Mission Assurance teams to conduct root cause analyses for issues identified during testing and sustainment.

Required Qualifications:

  • Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, manufacturing engineering or equivalent experience
  • Typically requires 4+ years of experience testing electrical hardware or other military based systems
  • Experience with mixed-signal Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) and system validation test development
  • Experience in developing and executing verification and validation test procedures.
  • Experience testing ruggedized servers for harsh environments (e.g., extreme temperatures, shock, vibration).
  • Ability to read and understand circuit and wiring diagrams, technical specifications and electronics test procedures
  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes with the ability to work on multiple projects in a highly demanding environment
  • Experience understanding system and subsystem requirements & specification generation processes
  • Knowledge of a wide variety of electronics test and analyzing equipment including oscilloscopes, analyzers, power supplies, meters and any other special electronics test equipment necessary for testing, analyzing and/or troubleshooting/repairing
  • Experience understanding engineering principles and demonstrated application of those concepts with a focus on safety and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience in LabVIEW, Python, Bash, C#,C++, MATLAB, or other programming languages used for data collection and analysis.
  • This role is 100% on-site and based in Torrance, CA.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active U.S. Secret Clearance.
  • Experience with military standards such as MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, and MIL-STD-1275.
  • Experience with Aerospace, Defense, Government, or Military sectors.
  • Skilled in documentation and collaboration platforms, including Confluence and SharePoint.
  • Experience with engineering lifecycle tools such as Jama, Jira, BitBucket.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to guide Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) through ambiguity and tight deadlines.
  • Experience supporting both military and commercial programs.
  • Working knowledge of military and aerospace standards including MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, DO-178C, and DO-254.
  • Hands on experience with environmental test equipment, including chambers used for hardware validation.

title: Global Operations Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

Build the trusted data foundation that powers intelligent operations. Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help shape the future of digital manufacturing through modern data engineering. As a Global Operations Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain enterprise data platforms that transform operational data into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets. You will build scalable data pipelines, cloud-native data solutions, and enterprise integration services while implementing data governance practices that ensure data quality, consistency, lineage, and reliability across Agilent's global operations. Working closely with Data Architects, AI & Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will enable a connected data ecosystem that supports enterprise applications, operational reporting, Artificial Intelligence, Smart Factory initiatives, and executive decision-making. We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering builds the digital foundation that powers Agilent's global manufacturing operations. Our organization develops enterprise software, AI platforms, cloud-native applications, smart factory technologies, and enterprise data platforms that connect manufacturing sites into one intelligent ecosystem. Our mission is to transform operational data into trusted insights and intelligent decisions that improve how products are designed, manufactured, tested, and delivered worldwide. Our portfolio includes: Manufacturing AI & Advanced Analytics, Global Operations Control Tower, Smart Factory & Industry 4.0, Enterprise Data Platform, Digital Twin Solutions, Manufacturing Knowledge Platform, AI-powered Decision Support, Enterprise Data Exchange Platform.

About the Role

Modern manufacturing depends on reliable, connected, and trusted data. Every day, enterprise systems, manufacturing equipment, industrial IoT devices, quality systems, and engineering applications generate vast amounts of operational data. The value of this data depends on the ability to integrate, manage, govern, and deliver it efficiently to the people and systems that rely on it. As a Global Operations Data Engineer, you will build the enterprise data platform that powers Agilent's digital operations. You will develop scalable data pipelines, implement data governance capabilities, and create reusable data products that enable analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital applications, and operational excellence. Your work will directly support initiatives such as the Global Operations Control Tower, AI-powered decision support, Smart Factory programs, Digital Twins, and enterprise reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Data Platform Development
    • Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise data pipelines that integrate data from Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, ERP, MES, and Industrial IoT platforms.
    • Build reusable data products and curated datasets that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI applications, and digital products.
    • Develop cloud-native data solutions that enable secure, scalable, and high-performance access to operational data.
    • Optimize data processing, storage, and orchestration to ensure platform reliability and scalability.
  • Data Integration & Engineering
    • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines supporting enterprise and operational systems.
    • Design APIs and integration services that enable seamless data exchange across enterprise applications.
    • Implement batch, streaming, and event-driven data processing architectures.
    • Collaborate with Software Engineers to expose trusted data through APIs and enterprise services.
    • Support enterprise integration across SAP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, cloud platforms, and operational technologies.
  • Data Governance & Quality
    • Implement enterprise data governance standards and best practices defined by the Data Architecture team.
    • Develop automated data quality validation, monitoring, reconciliation, and exception handling processes.
    • Maintain enterprise metadata, data lineage, and catalog information to improve discoverability and traceability.
    • Support Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives by ensuring consistency of critical business data.
    • Monitor enterprise data quality metrics and proactively resolve data integrity issues.
    • Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify Critical Data Elements (CDEs) and improve data reliability across operational systems.
    • Promote governance practices that ensure enterprise data remains accurate, secure, trusted, and fit for business use.
  • AI & Analytics Enablement
    • Prepare and maintain AI-ready datasets supporting Machine Learning and advanced analytics.
    • Collaborate with AI & Data Scientists to develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable analytical datasets.
    • Support semantic data models that enable self-service reporting and enterprise analytics.
    • Improve accessibility, consistency, and reuse of enterprise data across digital products and AI platforms.
  • Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement
    • Monitor the health, availability, and performance of enterprise data pipelines and services.
    • Implement observability, logging, monitoring, and alerting capabilities for critical data platforms.
    • Apply DevOps and CI/CD best practices to automate deployment, testing, and operational support.
    • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and engineering practices to improve the enterprise data platform.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
    • Partner with Data Architects to implement enterprise data architecture, standards, and integration strategies.
    • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and IT teams to understand business requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
    • Work closely with Software Engineers and AI teams to integrate trusted data into enterprise applications and intelligent solutions.
    • Support enterprise digital transformation initiatives across Agilent's global operations.

Technology Environment

  • Programming & Data Engineering: Python, SQL, Apache Spark, dbt
  • Cloud & Data Platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, Snowflake
  • Integration & Streaming: REST APIs, Azure Event Hub, Apache Kafka, Data Factory
  • Enterprise Systems: SAP ERP / S/4HANA, SAP ME / MES, PLM, Quality Management Systems, Industrial IoT Platforms
  • Data Governance: Microsoft Purview, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Catalog, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Quality Monitoring
  • DevOps: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Docker, Analytics, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Streamlit (preferred)

Qualifications Required

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical leadership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Integration, or Enterprise Data Platforms.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions.
  • Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, API integration, and enterprise data management principles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Passion for building modern data platforms that enable digital transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous: Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, or Enterprise Operations.
  • Cloud-native Data Platforms (Azure, AWS, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Data Lakehouse or Data Warehouse Architecture.
  • Event-driven Data Processing.
  • Data Governance, Metadata Management, or Master Data Management (MDM).
  • Artificial Intelligence or Advanced Analytics Platforms.
  • Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT, or Smart Manufacturing.
  • DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Additional Details

Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
